jobs.title: Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena is seeking a delivery-focused Services Project Manager to lead customer engagements and service delivery projects across the United States East Coast region. This role drives project execution across the full delivery lifecycle while aligning customer commitments, operational objectives, and financial outcomes. Success in this position comes from coordinating cross-functional teams, managing project complexity, and delivering consistent customer results.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead customer-facing service delivery projects across the full project lifecycle.
Coordinate project scope, schedules, milestones, resources, and execution activities.
Implement communication plans and provide project status updates, risk visibility, and resolution tracking.
Conduct risk assessments and execute mitigation plans throughout project delivery.
Chair customer and internal project meetings to communicate progress, issues, and delivery outcomes.
Monitor project execution against scope, resource utilization, budget expectations, and delivery commitments.
Interface with customers, engineering teams, sales, bid management, service delivery groups, partners, and finance teams to achieve project and business objectives.

The Must Haves

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field.
Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Service Delivery, Project Management, Service Coordination, or a relevant industry.
Utilization of project management tools.
Application of network lifecycle activities including design, deployment, migration, and validation.
Background in optical transport and networking environments including DWDM and L0/L1 technologies.
Experience interacting with customers, cross-functional delivery teams, and engineering resources.
Demonstrated influencing and collaboration across multiple teams.

Nice To Haves

Certifications: PRINCE2 certification preferred.
Certifications: PMP certification preferred.
Application of effort estimation, cost drivers, and delivery risk evaluation.
Background contributing to commercially sound decisions during presales and delivery activities.
Experience working in matrix environments with multiple stakeholders.
Outstanding planning, scheduling, and coordination skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Pay Range

The salary range for this role, in the USA, is $79,900.00 -$ !27,700.00 USD.

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager – Revenue Cycle
jobs.description:
About The Auctus Group LLC

Who we are:

We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work . Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that.

Who we’re looking for:

Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if:

you like a fast-paced environment,
you thrive with change and development,
you like giving feedback,
you’re a team player,
you love learning/sleuthing,
you’re big on accountability.

Department:

Operations / RCM (Client Services)

Job level:

Manager

The Implementation Manager leads onboarding and integration of new dermatology and plastic surgery practices into our revenue cycle operations. You will combine hands-on medical billing expertise with project management to coordinate system setup, billing workflows, team readiness, client communication, and post-launch stabilization, so every practice goes live accurately and on time. As we grow, including through acquisitions, this role helps new practices move into consistent, scalable operations and protects billing quality from day one.

About Us

The Auctus Group is a specialty billing company serving dermatology, plastic surgery, and aesthetic practices. We are part of ProCode, which builds technology and AI tools for healthcare revenue cycle management. We handle Protected Health Information every day, so we hold ourselves to high standards for security, quality, and compliance.

What You Will Do

Lead implementations end to end. Own each new practice launch from discovery and planning through system setup, workflow design, go-live, and post-launch support.
Be the revenue cycle expert. Apply hands-on knowledge of charge capture, CPT and ICD-10 coding, claims submission, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, and patient billing to every implementation.
Coordinate across teams. Work with Billing, Coding, Business Intelligence, Training, and Operations to complete onboarding requirements and confirm each practice is ready to go live.
Manage risk. Identify and reduce risks in payer enrollment and setup, credentialing, authorizations, billing workflows, and data or process handoffs.
Set up the right tools. Oversee the configuration and use of practice management and billing tools, including ProCollect, electronic medical records, and clearinghouses.
Be the client's main contact. Manage expectations, decisions, timelines, issues, and status updates throughout the implementation.
Build a repeatable process. Develop and maintain standardized implementation plans, documentation, checklists, procedures, and best practices.
Stabilize after go-live. Monitor billing performance, resolve launch issues, and coordinate corrective actions until operations are steady.

What You Bring

5+ years of medical billing and revenue cycle management experience, with a strong hands-on understanding of operational billing workflows
Proven experience leading practice implementations, client onboarding, or complex operational process transitions
Deep understanding of payer rules and reimbursement, denial and appeal processes, insurance verification, authorizations, and claims operations
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to manage multiple implementations at once
Excellent client-facing communication and cross-functional collaboration skills in a remote work environment

Nice to have

Experience with dermatology and/or plastic surgery billing
Experience supporting multi-entity or multi-specialty organizations, particularly through practice acquisitions or integrations
A continuous-improvement mindset, including Lean principles or experience standardizing scalable processes

How Success Is Measured

On-time, successful practice go-lives, with implementation milestones met
Lower post-implementation billing error rates, with healthy clean-claim and denial-rate performance
A positive client onboarding experience and timely issue resolution
A short time to stabilize accounts receivable and overall revenue cycle performance after launch

Compensation And Details

Background screening is required for all Auctus Group team members, including new hires, because of our work with PHI.

jobs.title: Program Manager, DIGITAL Project
jobs.description:
Who We Are

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision

Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

About The DIGITAL Project

DIGITAL (Digital Integration for Grid Interconnection Tools, Analysis, and Logic) is a $90M project funded by a Department of Energy (DOE) grant and GridUnity cost share under the DOE’s Grid Resilience and Innovation Partnerships (GRIP) Program. The project's objective is to accelerate the interconnection of energy resources to the U.S. electric grid by shortening the complete interconnection lifecycle.

About The Role

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Program Manager owns the administration and execution of the DIGITAL project end to end. This role will drive successful delivery by hitting project milestones, managing the $90M project budget, surfacing risk early and actioning mitigations, and submitting DOE deliverables.

This is a heavy execution role that also requires coordination across all GridUnity departments. The DIGITAL project plan is fulfilled by GridUnity's Product, Engineering, Customer Experience, and FinOps teams, so you will work across every part of the company to keep the project plan synchronized with the product roadmap and actual customer delivery. You will be the connective tissue between the goals of the DIGITAL project, what GridUnity develops and deploys, and what we report and invoice to the DOE. You should be equally comfortable running a milestone review with product and engineering leads, walking a DOE project officer through a quarterly report, and defending the project's spend plan line by line.

Responsibilities

Project plan and execution

Own the Project Management Plan (PMP) and drive execution of the project plan across all tasks: schedule, milestone log, deliverables log, metrics, and risk register.
Run the project's operating cadence: Milestone reviews, cross-functional status, and executive updates so that progress is visible and decisions get made on time.
Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience to ensure the PMP accurately reflects the progress of the product roadmap and customer deployment, and manage formal updates to the plan when actual delivery and the baseline plan diverge.

Budget management

Manage the project to its approved budget: track actuals against the spend plan by task and budget category, across both federal share and GridUnity cost share.
Identify budget under- and over-utilization early, work with finance and functional leads on corrective action, and manage re-budgeting when needed.

Risk management

Own the project risk register: identify emerging gaps between planned milestones and current trajectory, surface them with options rather than surprises, and drive mitigation to closure.
Monitor dependencies across workstreams and escalate conflicts between project commitments and other company priorities.

DOE reporting, invoicing, and compliance

Prepare and submit DOE reporting deliverables including quarterly progress reports and annual go/no-go review materials
Own preparation of invoices to DOE, ensuring costs are allowable, allocable, and supported by documentation that will stand up to audit.
Demonstrate the value of actualized spend in advancing the project's goals: connect dollars spent to milestones achieved, software released, and deployments completed in every report and review.
Serve as day-to-day point of contact with the DOE project officer and grants management specialist, and coordinate GridUnity's responses to DOE requests.

Qualifications

Director-level program or project management experience (10+ years), with a record of owning large, multi-year programs end to end: plan, budget, risks, and reporting.
Experience with Department of Energy awards, as a recipient, contractor, or DOE staff, including federal reporting, invoicing, and the mechanics of managing the award
Background in the electric grid and utility sector; familiarity with interconnection strongly preferred.
Experience managing programs built on SaaS product delivery. Comfortable working with product and engineering teams on roadmaps, release cycles, and agile development.
Strong cross-functional operator: able to drive outcomes through teams that don't report to you, from engineering leads to finance to executives.
Excellent written communication; able to produce federal-grade reports and briefings independently
Project Management Professional certification or equivalent is a plus. U.S. work authorization requi

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

Benefits/Perks

Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions
Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance
Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one
Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you
401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future
Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance
Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com
.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @
gridunity.com
.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Professional Services Program Manager at GitLab, you will lead the delivery of complex, multi-workstream services engagements for some of our largest and most strategic customers. You will help customers turn transformation goals into clear execution plans by bringing structure, visibility, and accountability across interconnected projects. Working closely with customer stakeholders and GitLab team members, you will guide programs from planning through delivery while building trusted relationships across executive, technical, and delivery teams. In this role, you will define and apply a strong delivery methodology grounded in agile and project management best practices, communicate that approach clearly, and keep teams aligned on milestones, dependencies, and outcomes. This is a strong opportunity to shape how customers adopt GitLab at scale and help them realize meaningful business value through effective program leadership.

What you'll do

Lead delivery of multi-workstream professional services engagements for large and strategic customers
Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive leaders, program and project managers, engineering, development, and security teams
Develop and apply a delivery methodology that uses agile and project management best practices, and communicate how the methodology will be used throughout the program
Create and continuously communicate program roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across connected projects
Manage stakeholder expectations and secure approval on major milestones, decisions, and delivery plans
Define program strategy, including business justification, expected benefits, in-scope and out-of-scope work, timelines, schedules, resources, stakeholders, and success criteria
Establish core program structures such as RACI charts, work breakdown structures, communication plans, and escalation paths
Work closely with Engagement Managers and Regional Delivery Managers to support program scoping, review delivery assumptions, and help improve project management processes through quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)

What you'll bring

Experience leading complex programs with multiple interdependent projects, stakeholders, and timelines
Strong skill in program planning, forecasting, reporting, and communicating delivery metrics clearly to internal and external stakeholders
Ability to organize, monitor, and manage long-term project budgets, schedules, risks, and dependencies
Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with customers and partner effectively with Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery teams
Working knowledge of agile and other project management approaches, with the judgment to apply the right structure to different customer needs
Ability to develop long-term plans that support customer adoption, transformation, and successful delivery outcomes
Comfort leading program-level meetings and driving progress across multiple workstreams
Willingness to complete GitLab Project Management certification within 2 months of starting in the role

About The Team

On our Professional Services team, we help customers adopt GitLab effectively by turning strategy into structured delivery. As Program Managers on our team, we bring clarity to large, complex engagements by coordinating people, plans, and processes across multiple workstreams. We work closely with customers, Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery leaders to create practical plans, manage risk, and keep programs moving toward agreed outcomes. Because we operate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, we value clear communication, strong documentation, and ownership. This role is well suited for you if you enjoy building order in complex environments, guiding stakeholders through change, and helping customers make progress on meaningful transformation efforts.

jobs.title: Project Manager (technical content)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Prowess Consulting is a technology consultancy that helps some of the world’s largest technology enterprises define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We invest the time to deeply understand our clients’ technologies, customers, and business objectives so we can help them develop the strategies and stories they need to succeed in the market.

Who You Are

Prowess is looking for a detail-oriented, efficient problem solver with experience managing engineering and content development projects to successful completion, ideally in a fast-paced consulting or marketing agency environment. You’re comfortable using AI to take on the administrative side of project management so you can spend more of your time on clients, the team, and quality.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time or role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please
.

THE ROLE

As a Project Manager, you are central to keeping our projects on track, our clients and stakeholders satisfied, and our project team feeling connected and accomplished. On any given day you might review test results with engineers, animation storyboards with graphic designers, and a draft white paper with a client, all while keeping timelines, scope, and budget on track. You’ll manage multiple projects in parallel for leading high-tech companies worldwide.

AI is taking over much of the administrative layer of project management and we see that as an opportunity. We want PMs who use that freed-up time for what people do best: facilitating decisions, building client trust, supporting the team, and raising the quality bar. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should have hands-on experience with AI and real curiosity about how fast they’re changing.

Responsibilities

Project delivery

Manage engineering and content development projects for tech clients from kickoff through closeout.
Lead client kickoff calls and align teams on scope, deliverables, templates, and review cycles.
Coordinate activities, handoffs, and deliverables across engineers, writers, editors, and designers.
Build and manage full lifecycle project plans and schedules for multiple projects in parallel.
Run focused working sessions that drive decisions, unblock teams, and keep progress moving week over week.

Client and stakeholder management

Generate clear status reports and executive emails highlighting progress, open items, and risks.
Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact; address and escalate client concerns as needed.
Expertly facilitate meetings by reading, prioritizing under time pressure, and deciding when to push for a decision and when to take a topic offline.

Budget, scope, and risk

Manage project budgets, hours, and margin, including scope and change requests.
Identify risks early and bring recommendations, not just problems.

AI-enabled ways of working

Use AI to handle routine project work, such as meeting notes, status drafts, schedule updates, and risk tracking, while staying fully accountable for accuracy.
Review AI-generated output with sound judgment, internal policies and client requirements.
Share tips with teammates and help improve team templates, SOPs, and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

4+ years of project management experience, preferably in consulting or marketing agencies.
Strong interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback.

Job ID:
LP_00025926-2661758

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Operations Project Manager's primary function is to lead the strategy, reporting, tracking and execution of projects for Operations. Coordinates and manages the programming, planning, implementation and monitoring of complex department-wide projects, initiatives, and ongoing efforts. In partnership with the department leadership, uses data, SWOTs and focus groups to analyze issues in order to identify projects that support strategic plans and goals. Ensures the completion of projects are on schedule and meet all program objectives and appropriate regulations. The Project Manager will bring new and innovative ideas, techniques, and opportunities to the forefront to foster continuous improvement in strategy execution. Facilitates cross functional relationships with key stakeholders in order to align goals, strategy, and deliverables.

Essential Functions

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

In collaboration with department leadership, develops and presents business cases to obtain project sponsorship, budget, and resource allocation.
Identifies appropriate project team members and stakeholders and completes a RACI to outline expectations regarding roles and responsibilities.
Manages, assesses, and documents project scope and program, describing the objectives, stakeholder identification, resource requirements, parameters, risks and benefits of the project, timelines and tracks and communicates ongoing performance against goals.
Develops and maintains project charters to include purpose, objectives, scope, risk mitigation, metrics, timeline, communication plan, and deliverables, debrief, and measurements.
Documents current and future-state processes and oversees the development and implementation of operational workflows.
Ensures projects are progressing at appropriate timelines. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity and quality goals and deliverables.
Monitors project deliverable progress and impacts and adjusts as needed.
Manages communications on a regular and timely basis, ensuring that all project participants are informed of project status, barriers, and required actions. Creates communication and change management plans for all types of stakeholders. Conducts project debrief sessions, identifies lessons learned, and applies the lessons learned to future projects.
Captures data, performs analysis, interprets results, develops summaries, and generates optimal, effective, and innovative visual display to inform and operationally support department leaders and business operation improvement initiatives and priorities.
Manages complex information (e.g. large data sets), conducts analyses and develops visual displays on a regular basis in collaboration with the department leaders to help identify needs, drive results, and measure effectiveness. Supports operational leaders and team by developing and managing metrics to enable data driven decisions.
Implements quality control measures to ensure project compliance with department, hospital, and university policies, government codes and regulations. Ensures conformance to the requirements of all project participants.
Identifies when project proposals are warranted by using data analytics, survey data, SWOTs, workforce planning, and focus groups. Conducts a root cause analysis and problem statement.
Develops and manages implementation plans for all projects. In collaboration with applicable partners, develops and implements training around project deliverables that result in changes in process, procedures, policy, etc.
Continuous evaluation of workflow processes. Leads process optimization efforts by leveraging usage of technology.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a work - related discipline / field from an accredited college or university

Experience:
Three (3) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

License / Certification:
None required. Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

Ability to apply judgment and make sound decisions.
Ability to foster effective working relationships and build consensus.
Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, work independently and meet deadlines.
Ability to work effectively both as a team player and leader.
Ability to work effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization.
Knowledge of Windows-based office software, computers and operating systems.
Knowledge of research processes, data development, data analysis, syndicated data and consumer information resources.
Experience in using effective project management tools and methods.
Ability to work in a matrix environment with multiple stakeholders and clients.
Ability to conduct research, conduct analysis, reach conclusions, and present findings.

Physical Requirements

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Project Manager
is responsible for the success of large strategic projects. As needed, they may also provide management for a small program and will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering cross-functional IT projects across the organization in alignment with enterprise delivery standards and governance. They plan, execute and implement projects to deliver intended business outcomes, ideally on time, on budget and within scope according to business priorities. Throughout the lifecycle of the projects, the Senior Project Manager ensures consistent, reliable, and transparent project execution which effectively and efficiently utilizes organization resources.

This position reports to the Director IT Project and Portfolio Management and is part of the Information Technology (IT) team. There is a preference for candidates who can work on-site in Coralville, IA, or Fargo, ND.
While this req is posted as on-site in the US, applications from qualified candidates in other US locations
will be considered equally.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Plan and manage IT projects across multiple domains, including application, infrastructure, platform, and digital initiatives.
Develop and maintain project plans, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, and resource needs while ensuring projects follow defined delivery methodologies, standards, and governance processes.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure effective execution and issue resolution.
Track and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating as appropriate through governance channels.
Provide clear and timely project status reporting, including milestones, risks, and delivery health

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline. PMP certification strongly preferred.
Prefer minimum of five years project management experience serving in the role as a project manager
Knowledge and experience in the use of project management and SDLC methodologies and tools demonstrated mastery of process change, product development, manufacturing or software development.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in addition to facilitation and presentation skills.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel – list specifics 5% travel, overnight, within territory or locations
Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 0 lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Project management, DBS certification (i.e., visual project management, problem solving, daily management, etc.)

IDT, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

At IDT we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for IDT can provide.

The salary range for this role is $95K – 130K per year. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. jobs.title: Project Manager-Retail Bank Renovations
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend
is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend
is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of retail banking branch renovation and refresh programs. The ideal candidate will be client-focused, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple fast-paced projects while ensuring consistency, quality, budget adherence, and minimal disruption to banking operations. Role requires 25%-30% regional travel to project sites when required.

Responsibilities

Manage multiple branch renovation and retail banking improvement projects from initiation through closeout.
Coordinate and manage stakeholders including banking clients, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, facilities teams, and regulatory authorities.
Develop, monitor, and maintain project schedules, ensuring key milestones, critical paths, and delivery commitments are achieved.
Ensure effective project governance, standards, processes, and reporting frameworks are consistently applied across all projects.
Prepare and deliver project status reports, executive summaries, risk registers, and leadership updates.
Oversee the execution of branch renovations to ensure compliance with client design standards, brand requirements, security protocols, and operational needs.
Manage project budgets, forecasts, change orders, and cost controls to ensure projects are delivered within approved financial parameters.
Coordinate planning and execution activities to minimize disruption to branch operations, customers, and employees during renovations.
Facilitate communication between internal stakeholders, construction teams, vendors, and banking operations teams through regular meetings and project updates.
Monitor design development, permitting activities, procurement schedules, construction progress, and project closeout requirements.
Manage contractor and consultant performance, ensuring quality, safety, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
Review project documentation, drawings, schedules, budgets, and contractor deliverables to ensure alignment with project goals.
Lead issue resolution efforts, including responding to field conditions, RFIs, change requests, and operational challenges.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to support successful project delivery.
Support value engineering initiatives and recommend cost-effective solutions without compromising quality, customer experience, or regulatory compliance.
Ensure all renovations are completed in accordance with applicable building codes, accessibility requirements, life safety standards, and banking security guidelines.
Maintain strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify opportunities for program improvements, process efficiencies, and expanded services within the retail banking portfolio.
Support business development efforts by fostering positive client relationships and identifying future project opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience managing retail, banking, corporate interiors, renovation, or construction projects.
Experience overseeing multi-site renovation programs and fast-track project delivery environments.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and construction administration.
Experience working in occupied facilities while maintaining business continuity.
Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, and project management software platforms.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Project Manager (technical content)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Prowess Consulting is a technology consultancy that helps some of the world’s largest technology enterprises define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We invest the time to deeply understand our clients’ technologies, customers, and business objectives so we can help them develop the strategies and stories they need to succeed in the market.

WHO YOU ARE

Prowess is looking for a detail-oriented, efficient problem solver with experience managing engineering and content development projects to successful completion, ideally in a fast-paced consulting or marketing agency environment. You’re comfortable using AI to take on the administrative side of project management so you can spend more of your time on clients, the team, and quality.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time or role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please
.

THE ROLE

As a Project Manager, you are central to keeping our projects on track, our clients and stakeholders satisfied, and our project team feeling connected and accomplished. On any given day you might review test results with engineers, animation storyboards with graphic designers, and a draft white paper with a client, all while keeping timelines, scope, and budget on track. You’ll manage multiple projects in parallel for leading high-tech companies worldwide.

AI is taking over much of the administrative layer of project management and we see that as an opportunity. We want PMs who use that freed-up time for what people do best: facilitating decisions, building client trust, supporting the team, and raising the quality bar. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should have hands-on experience with AI and real curiosity about how fast they’re changing.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project delivery

Manage engineering and content development projects for tech clients from kickoff through closeout.
Lead client kickoff calls and align teams on scope, deliverables, templates, and review cycles.
Coordinate activities, handoffs, and deliverables across engineers, writers, editors, and designers.
Build and manage full lifecycle project plans and schedules for multiple projects in parallel.
Run focused working sessions that drive decisions, unblock teams, and keep progress moving week over week.

Client and stakeholder management

Generate clear status reports and executive emails highlighting progress, open items, and risks.
Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact; address and escalate client concerns as needed.
Expertly facilitate meetings by reading, prioritizing under time pressure, and deciding when to push for a decision and when to take a topic offline.

Budget, scope, and risk

Manage project budgets, hours, and margin, including scope and change requests.
Identify risks early and bring recommendations, not just problems.

AI-enabled ways of working

Use AI to handle routine project work, such as meeting notes, status drafts, schedule updates, and risk tracking, while staying fully accountable for accuracy.
Review AI-generated output with sound judgment, internal policies and client requirements.
Share tips with teammates and help improve team templates, SOPs, and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

4+ years of project management experience, preferably in consulting or marketing agencies.
Strong interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
Experience managing projects with technical content, such as benchmark testing, technical research, or white papers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple platforms.
Proven experience handling complex, highly fluid projects and challenging clients.
Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
Hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day work.
Solid experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

Preferred

Experience building simple automations or AI agents (for example, Power Automate or Copilot agents).
PMI’s Project Management Professional (PMP) credential; AI-focused project management training is a plus.

Additional Details

The offered pay range for this position is $80,000–$90,000 per year, depending on experience and geographic location.

Prowess Consulting is an equal-opportunity employer, and diversity is a core value for us. We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Prowess Consulting, we are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. We provide a well-rounded benefits package including health insurance, flexible spending account, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan investing. For more information, please visit www.prowessconsulting.com.

jobs.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

Project Managers assist with the management of eDiscovery cases by driving work through various operational departments to meet litigation project requests. This includes creating work orders for tasks associated with data intake, culling, processing, hosting and production and completing quality checks to ensure the accuracy and completeness of work product before it is released to clients.

What will this person do?

Maintain a good understanding of eDiscovery, market competitors and the tools used to support the industry
Develop a thorough understanding of Lighthouse workflows, critical paths needed to progress work through the system and tools used by Lighthouse to manage workflows
Communicate proper expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders
Manage the pod’s work request queue
Participate in process improvement initiatives as identified by pod leaders
Perform other related duties as assigned

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:

Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus)
4+ years of work experience with at least two years of eDiscovery experience
Relativity experience required.
PMP certification a plus
Strong analytical and logical skills
Strong project management skills including the ability to interpret a variety of instructions provided in written or oral form
Flexibility and adaptability to handle a changing and growing workload

Work Environment and Physical Demands

Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table
Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting
Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends)

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.

This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

Lighthouse offers a quality comprehensive benefits package including, medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.

jobs.description:
This position will offer you the opportunity to manage the execution of multiple transmission, substation and distribution projects. The position will involve coordinating with multiple internal and external departments to manage the life cycle of capital project execution.

Responsible for project execution, contract administration, planning and resource management
Take ownership for all aspects of project performance including safety, schedule, budget, reporting and client experience through entire project life cycle
Accountable for all phases of the project life cycle from initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/controlling, and close out
Manage and direct the project team to ensure accountability; mentor and coach team members
Develop and maintain a positive working relationship with client functional leads and stakeholders
Lead efforts to ensure projects are completed safely, satisfactorily, on time, and within budget
Support the reporting of key performance indicators for schedule, budget and other dashboard items
Identify and control construction risk
Recognize, identify, track and control change
Communicate and consult with appropriate stakeholders and supervisors
Prepare reports that project information in a clear and concise manner and meet client requirements
Analyze issues and provide solutions to improve results

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills And Experience

12+ years of experience in Project Management of Utility, Construction, Engineering, or other relevant experience
Proven experience managing multi-disciplinary teams
Experience in capital project management
Experience within the energy, power, or utility industry
Experience with serving as a firm/client liaison in a support or lead role
Ability to multitask and manage multiple competing priorities is critical to success
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work in a collaborative team setting
A high school diploma or GED
Comfortable with a pproximately 10-25% domestic travel

Valued But Not Required Skills And Experience

A BS in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar degree
Engineering design experience is a plus
PMP Certification is a plus
Construction/field knowledge or experience is a plus

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.

We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.

Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. Help bring renewable energy projects closer to grid connection by keeping technical delivery, customer commitments, and project finances aligned. As a Technical Project Manager at Opoura, you will lead Power Engineering projects from start to finish, connecting the people and decisions needed to deliver them.

Based in Porto, you will join a team that collaborates closely across Europe and the US and works side by side with Software and SCADA colleagues to make sure control requirements and operational realities are reflected in our analyses.

Your role

You will report to Gil Almeida, Project Manager & Team Lead, and be based at our Porto office, where we currently have six colleagues.

You will join the Power Engineering department within Opoura’s Digital Services business unit. The team works with customers on grid studies and connection processes for power plants, collaborating with Software and SCADA colleagues to reflect control requirements and operational data in its analyses.

You will be the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate engineering teams and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Working closely with the Power Engineering Manager, you will align resource planning and priorities with project commitments.

This is a project delivery role for someone who can engage confidently with power systems and grid connection requirements. You will lead technical clarifications and challenge assumptions and deliverables, while the engineering team remains responsible for technical design and calculations.

Key responsibilities

Own the delivery of Power Engineering projects from initiation through completion, managing scope, schedules, budgets, quality, dependencies, and customer commitments.
Coordinate customers, engineers, grid operators, and external partners, keeping technical interfaces, responsibilities, and deliverables clear.
Lead technical clarifications and review engineering deliverables against project requirements, grid codes, and applicable connection standards.
Manage project risks and deviations, resolve or escalate issues, and keep stakeholders informed of decisions and progress.
Maintain financial control, including budget monitoring and invoicing, and partner with the Power Engineering Manager on resource planning and priorities.
Contribute to consistent project governance and delivery practices that improve predictability and make effective use of engineering capacity.

To be successful in this position, you

Build customer trust through clear communication and reliable follow-through.
Apply sound technical judgment, knowing when to challenge an assumption and when to bring in engineering expertise.
Anticipate delivery risks and address them before they affect commitments.
Balance customer expectations, technical requirements, project finances, and available resources.
Bring structure to complex work while keeping decisions and communication practical.

Your background

You combine project management experience with a solid understanding of electrical power systems. You are comfortable discussing technical requirements with engineers and customers without needing to perform detailed engineering work yourself.

We imagine that you bring:
Experience managing technical projects with responsibility for scope, schedules, budgets, and delivery.
A solid understanding of power systems, electrical engineering, and grid connection processes.
Experience coordinating technical interfaces and stakeholders across customer-facing projects.
The ability to interpret grid codes, network standards, and connection requirements, and review their implications for project deliverables.
Familiarity with power system studies and assessments, such as load flow, short-circuit calculations, protection coordination, or reactive power.
Confidence managing technical clarifications and identifying risks in engineering deliverables.

What we offer

You will own projects that connect engineering work with customer outcomes and bring together power systems expertise and practical project leadership.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Work across Power Engineering, Software, and SCADA and engage with customers and other technical stakeholders.
Help strengthen project delivery practices and improve predictability.
Work on grid connection challenges where technical decisions and project delivery meet.
A hybrid role in Porto, with at least two days a week in the office.

We help energy companies unlock the potential of the energy transition with smart, scalable solutions. Visit Job site on 4–6-week maximum intervals throughout the project.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in using engineering tools and software to:
Develop project schedules and track progress against milestones and deadlines.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed.

Who You Are

As a Multi Domain Compliance Program Manager, you will play a key supporting role in helping product, engineering, and compliance teams meet requirements across several compliance domains, including Responsible AI (RAI), Privacy, Accessibility, and the Digital Markets Act (DMA), to help ensure the successful delivery of our client’s software projects.
This role is ideal for a well-rounded program manager who enjoys coordinating cross functional partners, managing structured processes, and helping teams understand and navigate compliance expectations. You will contribute to scaling responsible, safe, and compliant innovation through strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please .

The Role and Responsibilities

Cross Domain Program Coordination & Support
Support compliance teams in managing and updating feature inventories for multiple compliance programs.
Help organize regular reviews of new features and experiences; assist in capturing decisions and tracking follow-up actions.
Partner with engineering teams to help ensure they have the right information and resources to complete required compliance reviews.
Identify opportunities to streamline cross domain workflows and contribute suggestions to improve operational efficiency.
Engage with compliance area owners to help make sure that each area is ready for release.
Maintain clear communication channels with stakeholders, providing regular updates on bug resolution progress.

Tooling, Documentation & Guidance

Help update compliance guidance pages, consolidate information, and ensure consistent documentation across compliance programs.
Provide support with ADO work items related to compliance activities, including updates and partner team follow ups.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

Prepare and share regular status updates for shiproom meetings and compliance stakeholders.
Capture clear meeting notes, decisions, next steps, and action items to help maintain alignment across all participating teams.

Risk & Confidentiality

Handle sensitive compliance information responsibly and follow established data protection practices.

Required Qualifications

4–10 years of experience in program or project management, ideally supporting compliance, governance, regulatory, risk, accessibility, privacy, or similar cross functional initiatives.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into structured tasks for engineering and product teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with comfort working across diverse groups and levels.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) and Power BI, or similar tools, for tracking and reporting.
Ability to learn quickly across multiple compliance domains and support SMEs, even without deep specialization in any one domain.
Experience contributing to process improvements, workflow optimization, or compliance enablement programs.

Additional Details

The offered pay range for this position is $105,00 – 120,000 per year, depending on experience and geographic location.

We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. jobs.title: Sr Finance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.
This role is ideal for a structured, customer-centered operator who can bring clarity to complex situations, build alignment across teams, and translate individual escalations into systemic improvements.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will help customers operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We create opportunities to learn, grow, and master your craft in a high-growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, support each other, and hold ourselves accountable to high standards.

In this role, you will:

Own priority customer escalations end to end, including triage, action planning, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and real-time status updates to customers and executive stakeholders.
Serve as the single-threaded owner for complex escalations, creating structure and accountability across Sales, Finance, Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other partner teams.
Deliver clear post-mortems and executive summaries; track resolution progress, commitments, and follow-up actions through closure.
Analyze escalation themes and quantify business impact to identify and prioritize opportunities for process, product, and workflow improvement.
Lead cross-functional programs to improve the customer experience – standardize escalation workflows, service-level expectations, tooling, reporting, and dashboards.
Coach frontline teams on escalation prevention, de-escalation, customer communication, and effective use of escalation processes.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.

Success in this role will be measured by:

Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for high-severity escalations.
Improved post-escalation CSAT and NPS.
Increased percentage of systemic issues permanently fixed within 90 days.
Consistent SLA adherence and audit-ready escalation documentation.
Clear stakeholder accountability and completion of commitments arising from escalations.

Minimun requirements for the role: 

4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Support Operations, Trust & Safety, incident management, or a related function, including direct ownership of high-severity escalations.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional process-improvement programs from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to use data to make decisions, quantify impact, and prioritize work.
Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders in time-sensitive situations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex situations into clear executive-level updates and recommendations.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

PMP, ITIL, Six Sigma, or a comparable program, incident, or process-management certification.
Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or other complex customer-operations environment.
Experience building or improving escalation playbooks, SLAs, operating rhythms, dashboards, or audit-ready documentation.
Experience coaching customer-facing teams on conflict resolution, de-escalation, and prevention.

Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary: $102,042 USD - $154,350 USD
Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
