Description

The Moores Cancer Center (MCC) is one of just 53 NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Centers in the United States and the only one in San Diego County. As a consortium cancer center, it is a collaborative partnership between the UCSD: encompassing 28 departments, 6 schools (School of Medicine, Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, School of Public Health, Jacobs School of Engineering, School of Biological Sciences & the School of Physical Sciences), UCSD Health oncology hospitals and clinics; the basic and public health research and outreach of San Diego State University (SDSU), and the basic and translational research of the La Jolla Institute of Immunology (LJI). These various programs and units are all dedicated to fulfilling the Moores Cancer Center's mission of reducing cancer's burden. As such, it ranks among the top centers in the nation conducting the continuum of cancer research, providing advancedpatient care, and serving the community through outreach and education programs. As a top-ranking, future-oriented organization, we offer challenging career opportunities in a fast-paced and innovative environment. Moores Cancer Center follows a progressive philosophy ofcareer-path development for its employees including opportunities for cross-training, professional development, and progressive responsibility.

MCC's mission is to transform cancer care in our catchment area and beyond by driving exceptional scientific discoveries and innovations in prevention, detection, care, and training. MCC will make a global impact on improving health by reducing cancer burden through accelerateddiscovery and translation, compassionate and interdisciplinary care, education and community engagement, with the foundation of our core values - Excellence, Innovation and Risk-Taking, Collaboration, Diversity and Service.

The Clinical Trials Office (CTO) at UCSD's Moores Cancer Center administers many clinical trials on behalf of its member investigators, including trials sponsored by National Cancer Institute cooperative groups, pharmaceutical companies, and physician investigators.

Reporting directly to the CTO Associate Director, Clinical Operations, the Disease Team Project Manager supervises the day-to day activities of Clinical Research Coordinators, Data Coordinators and Long Term Follow-Up Coordinators of a specified Disease Team, including oversight and coordination of a large portfolio of complex oncology clinical studies. The incumbent is directly responsible for ensuring the team’s adherence to protocols, appropriate management and distribution of the clinical research workload, ensuring CRC and Data Coordinator compliance with sponsor requirements and federal regulations overseeing auditing and monitoring visits. The Disease Team Manager is responsible for supervising, administering, and achieving operational goals and objectives for implementation within his/her specific Disease Team, and is directly responsible for the management of Disease Team staff.

The incumbent will also play a key role in leading and managing pre-study site selection visits (PSSVs) including liaising with all appropriate medical service units (e.g., Investigational Drug Service, Pathology, Radiology, etc.) for the conduct of the trial, managing quality assurance and quality improvement goals and objectives. Provides direct supervision typically to professionals or skilled technical employees. Functions as advisor to unit and administration.

Analyzes and resolves problems, interprets policies (e.g., fiscal management, HR, contracts and grants, resource management in defined areas) and demonstrates solid subject matter knowledge. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action. Supervises staff to assure accountability and stewardship of department resources (operational, financial, and human) in compliance with departmental goals and objectives.

Supervises staff responsible for working with departments, staff, patients and families in using clinical research techniques. May assume full responsibility for the research in delegated studies. Receives assignments in the form of objectives with goals and the processes by which to attain them. Supervises daily operations, and performance requirements. Has full oversight for staffing, performance management, and programmatic workflow of project.

Coordinates and oversees clinical trials from inception through completion, including approvals, initiation (site visit coordination), and start up procedures, protocol implementation, recruitment, screening, enrollment, data management, maintenance of subjects, writing publications and finalization of sponsor requirements. Oversees and analyzes complex databases. Compiles data reports as needed. Provides team, investigators, and clinical fellows with guidance regarding study design and logistics. Supervises staff work assignments and schedules to meet clinical research goals and timelines. Meets regularly with assigned staff to set goals and ensure objectives are being met. Supports patient recruitment plan development and execution, in conjunction with the Office of Community Outreach and Engagement (COE) and other Marketing, Communications and Business Development functions. Work with PIs and Director to plan and implement multiple phase I, II & III studies in assigned disease group. In conjunction with the Regulatory Affairs Manager and Start-Up Project Manager, monitor and ensure regulatory paperwork is submitted to the scientific committee for proposal review and monitor progress of regulatory approvals. Independently participate in onsite study monitoring visits, demonstrating proficiency in data management practices. Assure timely and accurate design and submission of reports, proposals and data collection instruments (instruments includes surveys and equipment for the study), with minimal protocol deviations and mitigations against delayed data entry

Supervises staff responsible for working with departments, staff, patients and families in using clinical research techniques. Participates in recruitment and orientation of new employees. Recommends salary actions, promotions, and terminations. Conducts necessary personnel actions for assigned staff including disciplinary actions. May assume full responsibility for the research in delegated studies. Receives assignments in the form of objectives with goals and the processes by which to attain them. Supervises daily operations, and performance requirements. Supervises staff work assignments and schedules to meet clinical research goals and timelines. Works with the Disease Team members to implement structural changes within the Disease Team and reassign projects as needed to maximize time efficiency within the constraints of limited resources. Trains and mentors staff to improve quality and quantity of work. Has full oversight for staffing, performance management, and programmatic workflow of project.

Minimum Qualifications

Nine years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five years of related experience/training.
Clinical Trial Professional certification from a professional society within one year in position.
Broad knowledge of clinical or laboratory research and clinical research philosophy. Demonstrated ability to translate clinical research philosophy into business best practices in a trial setting.
Demonstrated project management skills. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, prioritize projects and meet the demands of a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. Adaptable to quickly changing priorities.
Demonstrated experience managing people with a wide range of educational backgrounds and skills. Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others. Demonstrated experience in training others in the field of research.
Demonstrates good problem-solving and analytical skills. Creatively addresses complex or new problems.
Strong communicator; includes verbal and written, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills. Clear and concise communicator. Ability to influence and negotiate.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including but not limited to: problem-solving, teamwork development, leadership, mentorship. Interpersonal skills to effectively motivate others. Works well with others to achieve common goals. Ability to cultivate relationships with multiple stakeholders at various levels of administration.
Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software. Effectively uses campus' clinical information and documentation application programs. Proven ability utilizing clinical trial management systems.
Skills to work collaboratively with other cross-functional teams. Ability to interface and collaborate with other members of an extended study team. Ability to influence / persuade. Proven ability to effectively coordinate and integrate programs with others in division, department, and organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS

Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.

Job Summary

The Staff Program Manager is the hands-on project manager for Agena Bioscience R&D. This is a project management role that owns the plans, schedules and status of R&D projects day to day. The portfolio includes new RUO assay and product development, transfers from R&D to manufacturing, sustaining work, and operational projects such as lab and facility changes.

Duties/Responsibilities

  Project ownership

Own the plan for each assigned project from kickoff through launch or transfer: scope, milestones, dependencies, resources and budget.
Build and maintain project schedules in Smartsheet that reflect what teams have actually committed to, and update them within one business day of an agreed change.
Keep a current RAID log (risks, actions, issues, decisions) for every project and act on risks before they become issues.
Run core team meetings: set the agenda, drive to decisions, and send notes with decisions, owners and due dates within one business day.
Track deliverables to completion. When a date is at risk, flag it before it slips, with the cause, the impact and a recovery plan.
Manage several projects in parallel across new product development, transfer to manufacturing and operational initiatives.

Reporting and communication

Send a complete weekly portfolio status on schedule, without prompting.
Maintain dashboards for leadership and phase gate reviews and have them current before every review.
Present status, risks and trade-offs to R&D and executive leadership clearly and briefly, including bad news.
Keep stakeholders informed so that no one has to chase project status.

 Design control and quality

Run projects within our design control process and QMS: phase gates, design reviews, document approvals and transfer to manufacturing.
Plan and track each project’s design control deliverables (requirements, verification plans and reports, risk documents, transfer packages) through approval.
Work with Quality on deviations, OOS investigations and CAPAs that affect project timelines.

  Building the practice

Set up and maintain project management tools and templates that fit a company of our size: schedules, RAID logs, status reports, dashboards and meeting notes.
Improve how R&D plans and tracks work, starting from what works here rather than a large company playbook.

Experience/Education

Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of project management experience, with at least 5 years managing cross-functional projects in a regulated product development environment (life science tools, diagnostics, medical devices, pharma or similar).
Track record as the accountable project manager on several concurrent projects, including at least one taken from concept through launch or transfer to manufacturing.
Experience working under design controls in an ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820 or ISO 9001 quality system.
Experience working without an established PMO, including having set up project tools and cadence without one.
PMP or equivalent certification preferred.
Experience in molecular diagnostics, genomics, or RUO assay or reagent development preferred.

  Knowledge and Skillsets Required

Expert-level project management skills, including planning, risk management, governance, and portfolio execution.
Strong understanding of design processes, product development lifecycles, and cross-functional operating models.
Proven ability to operate independently in highly ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.
Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Advanced stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource optimization.
Commitment to continuous improvement, scalability, and operational excellence.

Experience managing programs and contracts in a regulated biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device related field required
Working knowledge of plasmid DNA manufacturing and its use in cell and gene therapy, gene editing, mRNA, vaccines, or other genomic medicine applications; strong preference for late phase/commercial drug product experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to forecast risks and implement sustainable solutions.

jobs.description:
About Primordial Labs

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Program Manager to own a portfolio of programs across the full program lifecycle, from proposal and negotiation through contract award, execution, and fielding. You’ll work with the growth team to capture new and follow-on work, then serve as the single point of accountability for delivering on our commitments, on time. You’ll lead the day-to-day execution of your programs with support from Program Management Staff, setting the plan, making the calls, and keeping customers and leadership informed.

This role suits someone with 7+ years of program management experience, including time in an ownership role, who wants full accountability for outcomes and enjoys developing the people around them at a company where decisions get made quickly.

What You'll Do

Program Ownership & Execution:

Own one or more programs end to end, from contract award through fielding and sustainment.
Set program baselines for scope, schedule, cost, and performance, and manage execution against commitments.
Own the program schedule and budget, review schedule status and spend with Program Management Staff, and lead corrective action when programs drift.
Proactively make and document decisions on risk, tradeoffs, and recovery plans without waiting for escalation.
Work across the program management team and other stakeholders to integrate dependencies and balance competing priorities.

Proposals & New Business:

Partner with the growth team to capture new and follow-on work, shaping customer requirements and solution approaches.
Lead the program management portions of bids, including technical approach inputs, schedules, staffing plans, and basis-of-estimate development.
Lead or support customer negotiations, owning the program’s position on scope, schedule, and cost.

Contract Deliverables & Compliance:

Own contract deliverables, reviewing and approving work drafted by Program Management Staff and engineering before submission.
Manage period-of-performance milestones, invoicing, and government reporting.
Ensure contract terms are met, manage contract modifications, and flag issues to leadership early.

Do you enjoy managing complex projects, building strong customer relationships and ensuring that commercial commitments turn into successful deliveries?

At Opoura, our Digital Services business brings together engineering, technology, consulting and security expertise to support customers across energy and critical infrastructure. Our projects span Power Engineering, OT & SCADA and Managed Security Services, covering everything from grid connection studies and power system modelling to infrastructure and cybersecurity.

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Project Manager who can combine strong project management skills with commercial understanding and a customer-focused mindset.

Your role

As our new Commercial Project Manager, you will take responsibility for the commercial and financial performance of assigned projects while coordinating delivery across our technical teams and business units.

You will be a key point of contact for customers, ensuring clear communication, alignment on expectations and structured follow-up throughout the project lifecycle.

Based at our headquarters in Silkeborg, you will work closely with Technical Project Managers, specialists, and fellow project managers across Digital Services, alongside colleagues in Sales, Finance, and our Business Controller.

Beyond managing your own projects, you will contribute to developing common project management processes and strengthening project and portfolio reporting across Digital Services.

Your main responsibilities

Manage the commercial and financial aspects of assigned projects, including budgeting, forecasting, invoicing and project P&L.
Lead customer dialogue, manage expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout project delivery.
Coordinate project scope, planning, milestones and resources in collaboration with technical project teams.
Identify and manage project risks, changes and commercial implications.
Support Sales with project estimates, budget quotations and delivery planning.
Work closely with Finance and the Business Controller to ensure accurate financial follow-up and monthly management reporting.
Contribute to developing and implementing practical, shared project management processes across Digital Services.

To be succes in this role

You combine commercial awareness with a structured and pragmatic approach to project management.

You understand how project decisions affect financial performance, customer relationships and delivery commitments. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing the right people together and keeping projects moving forward.

You communicate clearly with both technical specialists and commercial stakeholders, and you know when to challenge, escalate or find a practical solution.

Most importantly, you take responsibility for your commitments and enjoy creating structure and progress in a technically complex environment.

Your background

We imagine that you bring:
At least five years of experience in commercial project management, including direct customer contact and responsibility for project financials and delivery coordination.
Solid experience with budgeting, forecasting, invoicing, project planning and risk and change management.
Practical experience with structured project delivery, primarily using waterfall-based approaches.
A PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent project management certification.
Confidence working with project management, financial and reporting tools. Experience with Business Central and Power BI is an advantage.
Fluent Danish and strong English communication skills.

A relevant higher education qualification is preferred, although practical project management experience is more important to us.

Experience from renewable energy or the wider energy sector is an advantage, but not a requirement. We also welcome candidates from engineering services, technical consulting, IT/OT, infrastructure and cybersecurity.

The position is based in Silkeborg and involves occasional travel to customers, project sites and other Opoura locations.

What we offer

At Opoura, you will have the opportunity to work close to the technologies and specialists supporting the energy transition.

You will join a collaborative environment where technical expertise and commercial understanding come together to deliver solutions for customers operating complex energy and critical infrastructure.

The position offers:
Ownership of your own projects, with responsibility for both customer relationships and commercial performance.
Close collaboration with experienced engineers, technical specialists and project managers.
The opportunity to work across different technical disciplines and business units.
An active role in improving how we manage, execute and report on projects.
An international environment where knowledge sharing, collaboration and trust are central to how we work.

About Opoura

We help energy companies unlock the potential of the energy transition with smart, scalable solutions. With Nordic roots and a strong footprint in North America and Europe, we bring decades of experience in software, hardware, and consulting to support our clients in connecting, controlling, and commercializing energy assets.

From IPPs to traders and TSOs, our clients trust us to navigate complex energy infrastructure, drive informed decisions, and boost performance. Backed by diverse teams and deep industry knowledge, we deliver impact across the energy value chain.

Our people make up one global team united by our diverse perspectives, working together to meet the unique needs of each region and each client we serve. We employ more than 240 dedicated employees in nine countries in Europe and North America, including Denmark, Germany, Poland, Ukraine, Spain, Portugal, Romania, the UK, and the US.

Join us, and together we ignite the potential of the energy transition in a smart way.

If this sounds like your next challenge and a journey you would like to be part of we’d love to hear from you. To be considered for this position, please fill out the application form below and upload your motivated CV.

We review candidates on an ongoing basis, so please don’t hesitate to get in touch.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The role leads the BAE Order Management (OM) team and coordinates across other functions without direct supervisory authority over those teams. Buyers retain responsibility for sourcing, purchasing decisions, and supplier management. The Program Manager communicates program priorities and customer impacts, coordinates dependencies, and works with functional leadership to resolve barriers to execution. The role also partners with TEVET’s BAE Account Manager to support the ABACO business, with specific responsibilities and decision authority established with the Account Manager and Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Team Leadership & Performance

Manage daily work assignments and priorities for the BAE OM team to support customer requirements and program commitments.
Monitor team workload, order accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through; address performance gaps and barriers to execution.
Provide coaching, training, and feedback to strengthen team capabilities and consistency.
Establish clear expectations and conduct performance reviews in accordance with company practices.
Coordinate team coverage and communicate staffing or resource needs to the Director of Supply Chain Operations.
Promote accountability, collaboration, adaptability, and customer service within the team.

Program Management & Execution

Develop and maintain practical operational plans with clear milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and action items.
Maintain visibility into open orders, delivery commitments, program exceptions, and outstanding issues.
Monitor program performance and identify risks that could affect service levels or customer commitments.
Develop and coordinate corrective action plans with responsible teams, following issues through resolution.
Balance multiple programs and time-sensitive requirements, resolving priorities within established authority and involving leadership when necessary.
Manage assigned customer onboarding, program implementations, process changes, and operational transitions.
Maintain program reporting, performance reviews, and action-item tracking.

Customer Relationship & Communication

Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned customer programs.
Maintain regular communication with customers regarding performance, priorities, delivery expectations, and outstanding issues.
Lead operational meetings, program reviews, and issue-resolution discussions.
Communicate risks, changes, and corrective actions promptly, using information validated with the responsible teams.
Set realistic expectations and follow through on commitments.
Partner with the Account Manager and TEVET leadership on concerns requiring commercial decisions, additional resources, or leadership intervention.
Build productive working relationships that support customer confidence and TEVET’s business interests.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Order Management

Coordinate activities across order management, procurement, sales, and other teams to support program execution.
Communicate customer requirements, program priorities, and delivery impacts to the responsible teams.
Lead the BAE OM team in resolving order discrepancies, missing information, fulfillment exceptions, and stalled handoffs.
Obtain relevant purchasing and supplier delivery updates from buyers to support program planning and customer communication.
Ensure cross-functional issues have an accountable owner, an agreed next step, and a target completion date.
Drive follow-through on agreed actions and escalate unresolved dependencies, missed commitments, and priority conflicts.
Work with other functional leaders to address shared resource constraints and recurring operational barriers.
Develop and maintain customer-specific order management procedures and ensure team activities follow established company processes and applicable customer and contractual requirements.

Tool Crib Program Support

Coordinate TEVET’s administrative and order management support for customer tool cribs.
Track supplier shipments based on crib usage and coordinate timely processing of related TEVET paperwork.
Maintain accurate records of each crib PO’s funded amount, amounts applied against the PO, and remaining available balance.
Reconcile shipment information and supporting documentation, working with the appropriate parties to resolve discrepancies.
Provide shipment status and PO funding updates to the Account Manager and designated stakeholders.
Identify and communicate approaching funding limits, documentation gaps, or shipment issues that could interrupt crib support.
Track funding-related follow-up actions with the Account Manager and responsible parties to support continuity of service.

ABACO Business Support

Partner with the BAE Account Manager to support operational execution and customer requirements associated with the ABACO business.
Coordinate assigned program activities, customer communications, reporting, and issue resolution.
Maintain visibility into related orders, delivery commitments, risks, and outstanding actions.
Work with responsible teams to address operational barriers affecting customer commitments.
Support assigned implementations, transitions, and process improvements.
Carry out additional program responsibilities as defined with the Account Manager and Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor agreed operational measures, including order accuracy, delivery performance, issue aging, action completion, and customer communication.
Monitor tool crib shipment documentation and PO funding balances to identify discrepancies and continuity risks.
Use metrics and feedback to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Implement practical improvements within assigned program and order management responsibilities.
Partner with functional owners on improvements affecting other teams’ processes.
Assess whether corrective actions achieve the intended results and address recurring problems.
Provide leadership with clear reporting on program performance, risks, and decisions needed.

Business Agility & Ownership

Independently manage assigned responsibilities and competing deadlines.
Adapt team priorities and program plans as customer needs and operational conditions change while keeping commitments clear.
Investigate problems, identify practical options, and take action within established authority.
Use collaboration and sound judgment to move work forward across teams.
Recognize when an issue requires another functional owner, the Account Manager, or leadership to make a decision.
Follow through consistently without requiring constant direction.
Balance customer needs with TEVET’s capabilities, commitments, and business interests.
Role boundaries: Buyers retain ownership of sourcing, supplier selection, purchasing decisions, supplier relationships, and purchasing issue resolution. The Program Manager manages BAE OM team assignments, workload, development, and performance. Other functional leaders retain responsibility for their respective teams. The Program Manager coordinates program dependencies, communicates customer impacts, and drives agreed actions forward.

Success Measures

Deliver program commitments by driving assigned activities against customer requirements, contractual commitments, and agreed milestones.
Maintain customer confidence through accurate, timely communication, effective reviews, and consistent expectation management.

Product Data Analyst

About The Role

SANY America is seeking a Product Data Analyst for its new Product Strategic Intelligence team within Product Management. The role combines market, residual value, parts, warranty, and other business data; develops repeatable models and algorithms; and produces reliable insights for leadership, dealers, and customers. The team creates tools and strategic sales models that help SANY America and its dealer network grow equipment and parts sales.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase its market share.

Data Funnels & Unified Platform:

Understanding of data quality, structured datasets, and documentation practices.
Clear written communication and ability to work with both technical and business partners.

Exposure to data pipelines, integrated reporting platforms, or automation with AI-assisted coding tools.
Knowledge of heavy equipment, machinery pricing, residual values, parts, or warranty data.
Experience testing models and reconciling results across different source systems.

Quantitative analysis, mathematical modeling, and sound judgment.
Data integration, cleaning, testing, and validation.
Excel, coding-assisted automation, and repeatable documentation.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you interested in working on a fast-paced team that pioneers ways to improve safety and compliance within North American Surface Transportation (NAST)? Do you enjoy digging into the details of an event and tracing it across multiple systems until you have a clear answer? Are you motivated by challenging problems where the answer isn't handed to you?

Amazon's NAST Safety & Compliance team, within Middle Mile Investigations (MMI), is seeking a detail-oriented Investigations Analyst to determine whether Amazon loads, equipment, or carrier relationships were involved in reported safety events across our carrier programs: Relay Marketplace Carrier (RMC), RMC LineHaul (RMCLH), RMC Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

Working within established investigation workflows and SOPs, with periodic review and guidance from the Program Manager, you'll review source documents such as police and crash reports, then match what they show (trailer and tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against internal load, assignment, and location records. Each event ends in a clear, documented determination of whether Amazon had involvement, backed by the evidence behind it. Along the way you'll spot issues that need follow-up, such as events that were never reported, or loads moved by a carrier other than the one assigned, and route them to the right partner teams. An ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, is vocally self-critical, and collaborates well in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Key job responsibilities

Investigation

Conduct assigned incident investigations from intake through documented finding across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP, determining whether an Amazon load, asset, or carrier relationship was involved.
Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash-camera footage, law enforcement and crash reports, and carrier documentation.
Match physical evidence (trailer/tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against load, assignment, and location records.
Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
Write clear investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, with every line sourced to verifiable data, so partner teams can act without re-investigating.
Serve as a point of contact on assigned incidents to internal stakeholders.

Analysis & escalation

Identify events needing follow-up (unreported incidents, mis-assigned loads) and route them to the appropriate partner teams.
Query and reconcile data across multiple transportation systems to support investigations.
Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices for Program Manager review.

Operating rhythm & process improvement

Work a steady queue of cases against turnaround expectations, keeping case records and queue status current and auditable in the systems of record.
Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness and escalate vendor performance issues.
Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
Flag recurring data or process gaps that slow investigations, and propose improvements to investigation standard work and SOPs.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About The Team

Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety & Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is geographically distributed, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. If you enjoy detailed problem-solving and are comfortable with ambiguity, you'll do well here.

Basic Qualifications

High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional or military experience
2+ years of experience working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications
Experience with investigations, auditing, risk management, compliance, or safety

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst, or equivalent role
Experience with end-to-end project management

jobs.title: Program Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Program Manager, Enterprise Risk Management, reports directly to the Director, Enterprise Risk Management. This role supports and advances CapMetro's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program through the execution of enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement activities. This position works collaboratively with executives, department leaders, project teams, and other stakeholders to facilitate risk assessments, maintain the enterprise risk inventory, monitor risks and opportunities, develop reports, dashboards, and presentations, and coordinate ERM activities. The Operational Lead provides consultative guidance, tools, and expertise to business units while serving in a facilitative and advisory capacity to support effective risk management. The position supports the Organizational Strategy & Projects leadership team in embedding risk-informed decision-making and fostering a risk-aware culture through sound risk management practices and program enhancement.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Note: The duties and primary responsibilities below are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this job and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. 

Enterprise Risk Management Program Administration

Support the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of CapMetro’s Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program, including risk appetite, risk tolerance, policies, procedures, tools, metrics, and templates.
Drive the integration of risk analysis, management, and recommendations into strategic planning, organizational objectives, and business decision-making.
Develop and deliver enterprise risk reporting, dashboards, risk maps, trend analyses, and executive, Board, and governance communications.
Maintain ERM program documentation, risk records, templates, reporting artifacts, and document repositories, ensuring accuracy, completeness, version control, and retention of program information.

Risk Identification, Assessment, Prioritization, and Monitoring

Maintain the enterprise risk register, facilitate enterprise and departmental risk assessments, and identify, assess, prioritize, and communicate risks and opportunities affecting strategic and operational objectives.
Monitor risk trends, emerging risks, key risk indicators (KRIs), and enterprise exposures against established risk appetite and tolerance thresholds, escalating material deviations as appropriate.
Develop and enhance risk monitoring and mitigation practices, including early warning systems, preventive controls, mitigation tracking, post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of risk management processes.

Business Partnership, Culture, and Influence

Foster a culture of risk awareness, collaboration, and transparency through stakeholder engagement, education, coaching, and constructive communication.
Partner with business leaders and serve as a trusted advisor to facilitate informed risk-based decision-making while reinforcing business ownership and accountability for risk.
Support change management and organizational transition initiatives by guiding cross-functional teams through the adoption of new processes, tools, and analytical practices, helping facilitate workforce readiness, user adoption, and successful integration of risk management into organizational decision-making and ERM objectives.
Promote analytical rigor and risk-informed thinking by developing organizational capabilities, methodologies, and practices that strengthen risk analysis, support data-driven decision-making, and embed risk discipline across the organization.

Strategic Project & Capital Program Risk Support

Partner with strategic initiative, capital project, program, and portfolio teams to assess, review, and manage risks associated with major capital investments and strategic initiatives, promoting cross-functional integrated risk management and informed decision-making.
Facilitate project risk workshops and monitor risk mitigation activities to support effective project risk management and decision-making.

Organizational Stewardship

Perform responsibilities in a manner that supports CapMetro's mission, values, strategic goals, and commitment to organizational excellence.
Support Capital Metropolitan Transportation Authority’s Safety Management Systems (SMS) process by following safety and security policies, considering safety in every action and reporting safety and security concerns.
Perform other duties as required and/or assigned in support of the CapMetro Strategic Plan.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING

Bachelor’s degree in risk management, business, economics, finance, public administration, management, or related field.
Eight (8) years of relevant experience in risk management, audit, compliance, governance, strategic planning, public administration, or related disciplines, including three (3) years of experience leading enterprise assessments, governance initiatives, and cross-functional business programs, with two (2) years of management experience managing employees or projects.
Preferred - Professional risk management qualification such as Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA), Enterprise Risk Manager (ERM), International Certificate in Enterprise Risk Management (IRM), Financial Risk Manager (FRM).
Preferred - Experience in public transportation, infrastructure, utilities, government, aviation, or large capital project environments.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Comprehensive knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) principles, frameworks, and practices, including risk appetite, risk tolerance, and industry standards such as COSO ERM and ISO 31000.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to perform qualitative and quantitative risk analysis, identify trends, evaluate impacts, and synthesize data from multiple sources to support decision-making.
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and program documentation in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to develop, maintain, and continuously improve systems, processes, documentation, and records that support effective risk management and program operations.
Proficiency in developing reports, dashboards, presentations, and other communication materials that effectively convey risk information and recommendations.

Description

Anderson Dahlen provides world-class specialty alloy fabrication and custom equipment manufacturing services. For more than 80 years, we have provided our customers with unparalleled craftsmanship and expertise across a wide range of projects in the food, pharmaceutical, industrial, and vacuum science markets. Anderson Dahlen is ISO 9001:2015 certified, as well as ASME, AWS, and PED compliant. Anderson Dahlen proudly joined the Gray family of companies in September 2020. The wage range for this role takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, certifications, as well as other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Our comprehensive health plan options, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, provide our team members with the tools they need for treatment, preventative care, exams, and prescriptions. ADI’s life, disability, and supplemental insurance options provide peace of mind and support to rely on in challenging times. Our team members overseas are offered private health insurance, life insurance, and an employee assistance program (EAP).

Visa Sponsorship: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Position Summary

The Operations Analyst is the single source of truth for the Pharma order stack. Sitting between the Business Unit (BU Leader, Account Manager, Order Entry) and the production floor, this role knows where every order is, what is ahead, what is behind, and why. The analyst gets that answer first-hand - from the ERP, the work centers, and the people running them - so no one else has to chase it.

The role combines data analytics with strong relationships across the organization. The analyst partners with the scheduling, production, and procurement teams, tracks orders against the master schedule, and feeds ground-truth status back from the floor. The analyst reports status and risk; the scheduling, production, and procurement owners fix the causes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Order tracker ownership: Owns the single source of truth of the Pharma order stack. Responsible for keeping it up to date, clean, and current.
Order tracking: Maintains real-time status of every open order from released PO to shipment. Verifies at the work center, not by email.
Data and analytics: Pulls and reconciles ERP data to build and maintain the tracking data, dashboards, and weekly reporting. Core metrics include on-time delivery, schedule adherence, WIP aging, and committed vs. projected ship dates.
Floor presence: On the production floor daily. Builds working relationships with supervisors and leads in every department an order touches.
Scheduling, production, and procurement partnership: Works with the scheduling, production, and procurement teams to track orders against the master schedule and material status, and feeds ground truth back from the floor. Supports the schedule but does not own it.
Ahead/behind analysis: Identifies slipping orders, quantifies the gap, and pinpoints the cause (unreleased prints, material shortages, capacity conflicts).
Early warning: Flags risk to the BU Leader and Account Manager before it hits a commit date - with the data and recovery options.
Delay patterns: Maps order flow from PO to ship and identifies recurring delay drivers. Hands findings to the owners to fix.
BU support: Provides status details for internal reviews and customer updates. Not customer-facing.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related engineering discipline - or equivalent job-shop experience.
2-4 years in production control, planning, scheduling, expediting, or operations analysis in a manufacturing or job-shop environment. Internships and co-ops count.
Advanced Microsoft Excel required (pivot tables, lookups, reconciling large data sets). Power BI or similar a plus. Will be tested in the interview.
ERP/MRP experience pulling order, routing, and labor data.
Reads engineering drawings, BOMs, and routings.
Comfortable on a production floor. Builds credibility with shop leads.

Physical Requirements

The company fosters a manufacturing-type environment. This position will primarily involve operating a computer at a desk in an office environment.

jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior Data Analyst – Technology is a senior individual contributor responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data sources and translating raw data into reliable, decision-ready insights that advance Medicare Advantage technology operations. This role partners with product managers, platform engineers, clinical operations, and compliance teams to gather requirements, define data structures, and deliver scalable analytical solutions aligned with CMS regulatory standards, HEDIS/STAR performance objectives, and audit requirements. Operating with an AI-first mindset, this analyst owns the end-to-end insight lifecycle — from requirements gathering in an agile environment to production-grade analysis and stakeholder delivery — and serves as the team's data subject matter expert. This role is a key driver of data quality, analytical depth, and operational performance across the technology organization.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Data Architecture: Gather business requirements in an iterative agile/scrum model and define structural requirements for new analytical applications, including data transformation processes and source-to-target mappings that ensure data integrity and traceability.

Healthcare Data Analysis & Profiling: Analyze structured and semi-structured healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — to conduct detailed data profiling, ad hoc analyses, and complex investigations of functional data issues.

Scalable Reporting & Pipeline Development: Design and build scalable reporting processes and production-grade data pipelines using advanced SQL, Databricks, and cloud-native tools that support ongoing analytical and regulatory reporting needs.

Regulatory & Compliance Analytics: Produce analysis supporting HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter submissions, and risk adjustment reporting to ensure the organization is audit-ready and compliant with applicable CMS and HIPAA standards.

Data Quality & Governance: Validate data accuracy across systems, apply schema validation and data contract enforcement, and own data quality validation logic to ensure that all outputs are decision-ready, traceable, and compliant with PHI/PII requirements.

AI-First Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and apply AI-assisted querying, automated data preparation, and natural language analytics tools to accelerate insight generation and increase analytical capacity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Data SME Guidance: Serve as the data subject matter expert for the team, collaborating with analysts, product managers, and platform/cloud engineers to deliver reliable data solutions and provide technical guidance to junior analytical resources.

Documentation & Technical Communication: Own technical runbooks, operational handoff materials, and source-to-target mapping documentation to ensure knowledge continuity, team efficiency, and audit-ready records.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities. The Senior Data Analyst is expected to provide analytical guidance and informal mentorship to junior team members and may independently manage all data analysis work for a given project from initiation through delivery.

Experience

Job Requirements

Required:

Minimum of 8 years of progressive data analysis experience, with a proven track record of building and supporting production-grade data pipelines and analytical solutions
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in healthcare data analysis, with direct exposure to medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider datasets
Advanced SQL skills, including complex query design, performance tuning, stored procedures, and data quality validation logic
Demonstrated experience working within scrum teams in an agile development environment, including experience with agile tooling (e.g., Rally or equivalent)
Experience working with both structured and semi-structured data ingestion patterns, schema validation, and data contract enforcement across systems
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams — working closely with analysts, product managers, and platform/cloud engineers to deliver reliable data solutions
Strong documentation and communication skills, with experience owning technical runbooks and operational handoff materials
Experience in a regulated, HIPAA-compliant data environment with PHI/PII datasets

Preferred:

Experience in a Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or managed care health plan environment with knowledge of CMS reporting, HEDIS, STAR ratings, risk adjustment, or encounter data submissions
Experience with data platforms including Databricks, Apache Kafka, or equivalent streaming and cloud-native analytics tools
Experience applying AI or automation tools to analytical workflows, including natural language querying, automated data preparation, or predictive modeling

Education

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered

Preferred:

Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline

Training

Required:

Demonstrated proficiency in advanced SQL through direct production work experience; equivalent hands-on experience accepted in lieu of formal training
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project work

Preferred:

Completion of relevant healthcare data analytics, data governance, or AI-augmented analytics training (e.g., AHIMA, CPHIMS, or equivalent)

Skills & Competencies

Technical/Role-Specific Skills

Advanced SQL & Data Querying: Expert-level SQL skills covering complex query design, performance tuning, stored procedures, and data quality validation logic across relational and cloud-based databases.

Healthcare Data Domains: Deep working knowledge of medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data, including EDI standards (834/837), HL7/FHIR, ICD-10/CPT codes, and CMS encounter data formats.

Cloud Data Platforms & Pipeline Engineering: Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data transformation tools (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)

Data Modeling & Architecture: Solid understanding of data modeling concepts — conceptual, logical, and physical — including source-to-target mapping design, schema validation, and data contract enforcement across integrated systems.

Data Quality & Governance: Demonstrated ability to assess data completeness, detect anomalies, apply quality validation logic, and enforce governance standards across regulated healthcare datasets.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Automation: Familiarity with AI-assisted querying, automated data preparation tools, and workflow automation to accelerate insight delivery and reduce manual analytical burden.

BI & Data Visualization: Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools for building scalable dashboards and executive-ready reports that translate complex data into clear operational views.

Licensure

Required: None

Preferred: None

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
First Merchants Bank is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our team! This position is a highly technical, business-focused analytics professional responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that improve the performance of the Consumer Line of Business (LOB). This role combines advanced Microsoft SQL or Snowflake SQL development, data analysis, analytical modeling, data visualization, automation, and AI-enabled analytics to solve complex business problems and support strategic decision-making. The Senior Data Analyst develops scalable analytical datasets, reporting solutions, dashboards, and models; identifies emerging trends, opportunities, and risks; and translates analytical findings into clear business recommendations. The position also leverages generative AI and emerging analytical technologies to improve the speed, quality, consistency, and scalability of analytics while maintaining appropriate validation, data quality,
governance, and human oversight. This position can be remote within our operational footprint.

As Part Of This Role You Will

Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL within Snowflake or Microsoft SQL to extract, transform, integrate, and analyze large and complex datasets.
Develop reusable analytical datasets, transformations, business logic, and data assets that support reporting, dashboards, modeling, and strategic analysis.
Integrate information from multiple and disparate data sources to create reliable, consistent, and scalable analytical solutions.
Develop and implement data-quality checks and validation processes to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and appropriate for business use.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recurring data and reporting processes.
Perform exploratory, diagnostic, and advanced analysis to identify business trends, performance drivers, risks, relationships, and opportunities.
Design, develop, test, validate, document, and maintain analytical models used to support Consumer business decisions.
Apply appropriate analytical and statistical techniques, including forecasting, segmentation, propensity analysis, scenario analysis, optimization, and other quantitative approaches.
Lead and/or support analytical modeling for business applications such as staffing, network planning, variable compensation, goal setting, customer behavior, growth, retention, and other Consumer LOB initiatives.
Effectively use generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate data discovery, SQL development, analytical workflows, documentation, research, quality assurance, automation, and problem-solving.
Critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs before incorporating them into analytical products or business recommendations.
Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging analytical technologies to improve processes, reduce manual effort, enhance analytical capabilities, and improve decision-making.
Design, develop, deploy, and maintain dashboards, business reports, and executive-ready data visualizations that provide clear insight into key performance indicators and business drivers.
Monitor business, customer, operational, and financial data to identify meaningful changes in performance and emerging trends.
Deliver insights and recommendations regarding potential areas of growth, optimization, efficiency, and performance improvement.
Conduct ad hoc analysis in response to emerging business priorities and strategic questions.
Partner across Consumer LOB departments and other areas of the organization to develop data driven strategies that improve business processes and decision-making.
Translate ambiguous or complex business questions and stakeholder requirements into clearly defined analytical approaches, reporting deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
Communicate analytical findings, methodologies, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Lead and/or participate in special projects as needed, including upgrades, integrations, new data sources, technology enhancements, and analytical initiatives.

To be successful in this position, we require the following:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, data analytics, data science, statistics, management information systems (MIS), business analytics, economics, finance, business, or a related quantitative field OR associate degree/two (2) years of college plus two (2) years of related work/military experience OR four (4) years of related work/military experience, plus the additional required experience listed below.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, business analysis, analytics engineering, data science, or a related analytical discipline.

The Following Would Be a Plus

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. Role Overview

🏎️ Driving Empire is the #1 driving game on Roblox, with around 20 million monthly players and 500+ million rows of data generated every day. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst
to be the go-to expert on that data and a close partner to the team shaping the game’s future.

You’ll own Driving Empire’s analytics end to end
, from designing telemetry and building data models to running A/B tests, creating dashboards, and maintaining our AI analytics agent. You’ll work side by side with product managers, game designers, and our partnerships, licensing, and marketing teams to turn player data into clear insights and recommendations. Your work won’t sit in a report:
your analyses and tests will shape decisions that go live within days or weeks, not quarters. 🚀

It’s also a chance to work on a game that partners with world-famous automotive and entertainment brands, on one of the biggest UGC platforms in gaming. If you love data, games, and cars, and want to see your impact on millions of players quickly, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Partner closely with product managers and game designers, using data to shape feature design and game priorities
Own the full A/B testing process: design, spec, set-up, analysis and recommendations
Deliver post-mortem analyses and key learnings after major updates and live events, and suggest what to test next
Run deep dives into player behaviour, such as churn, conversion, LTV and player segments
Investigate changes in key KPIs and deliver clear root cause analyses
Build dashboards and regular reports
Contribute to the weekly Numbers Review alongside the PM, shared with the whole company
Work with game designers on balancing, review balancing changes before release, and playtest and support releases
Spec telemetry for upcoming features, and help improve how telemetry is documented, specced and checked
Maintain and develop Driving Empire's dbt models and data structure
Maintain and develop the semantic view, skills and AI analytics agent for Driving Empire, and keep them accurate
Provide insights, projections and reporting for partnerships, franchise, licensing and marketing
Take part in cross-game and team-wide projects, and bring new methods and tools to the team

Who You Are

3–5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role
2+ years of games industry experience strongly preferred (mobile, F2P, live service, or UGC platforms)
A product mindset: you understand how features affect player behaviour, engagement and monetisation, and use data to shape product decisions
Deep understanding of core gaming KPIs (such as DAU, retention, ARPDAU, conversion and LTV) and what drives them, as well as game economies and monetisation techniques
Deep A/B testing expertise, from design and sample sizing to analysis, interpreting both statistical significance and practical impact
Experience with advanced analyses, such as cohort analysis, player segmentation, KPI forecasts and churn models
Advanced SQL (complex queries, window functions, performance tuning) on large datasets
Experience designing clear, complete telemetry that answers product and design questions
Experience with cloud data warehouses (we use Snowflake, but Redshift, BigQuery, or similar is welcome)
Proficiency with a data visualisation tool (we use Tableau, but Looker, Power BI, or similar is welcome)
Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for analysis
Clear, accurate, well-organised written reports, adapted for technical and non-technical readers

Nice to Have

Understanding of how AI agents and semantic views work
Experience building scalable data models with dbt, including data quality tests and documentation
Python proficiency for deeper analysis and automation

Passion for racing and driving games
Passion for cars!

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Data Analyst – Technology is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for querying, analyzing, and reporting on Medicare Advantage healthcare data to support operational decision-making and regulatory compliance across technology operations. This role works closely with the Senior Data Analyst, product managers, and platform engineers to translate business requirements into analytical outputs — including reports, dashboards, and data validations — within an agile development environment. The Data Analyst builds foundational expertise in healthcare data domains including claims, member/eligibility, and provider data, and contributes to the team's data quality and documentation standards. This position is a key development role on the path toward senior-level analytical ownership and growing specialization in Medicare Advantage data platforms.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Querying: Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — in support of operational reporting and ad hoc analytical requests.

Requirements Gathering Support: Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies and assist in translating business requirements into analytical specifications, data mappings, and reporting logic under the guidance of senior team members.

Reporting & Dashboard Support: Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools that present healthcare data clearly for operational and compliance audiences.

Data Quality Validation: Apply data quality checks, validate source-to-target mappings, and identify anomalies or inconsistencies in healthcare datasets to support data integrity and audit readiness.

Regulatory & Compliance Reporting: Support the production of HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter, and risk adjustment reporting outputs by executing defined analytical processes and validating results against established data standards.

Documentation & Process Support: Maintain analytical documentation — including query libraries, data dictionaries, and process notes — to support team knowledge continuity and operational handoff requirements.

Continuous Learning & AI Awareness: Develop familiarity with cloud data platforms, data modeling concepts, and AI-assisted analytics tools, and actively build skills that support growth toward the Senior Data Analyst level.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Experience

Job Requirements

Required:

3–5 years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a closely related analytical function
Demonstrated hands-on experience writing SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation in a production or near-production environment
Experience working with healthcare data, including at least one of the following domains: medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, or provider data
Working knowledge of reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI platform
Familiarity with working in an agile or scrum team environment, including participation in sprint ceremonies and iterative delivery
Experience in a regulated data environment with exposure to data quality validation, HIPAA requirements, or PHI/PII handling practices

Preferred:

Experience in a Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or managed care health plan environment
Exposure to CMS reporting requirements, HEDIS measures, STAR ratings logic, or risk adjustment data
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data transformation tools (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)
Experience applying AI-assisted or automated analytics tools to routine analytical workflows

Education

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Informatics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered

Preferred:

Progress toward or completion of a Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline

Training

Required:

Demonstrated proficiency in SQL through direct work experience; equivalent hands-on experience accepted in lieu of formal training
Working knowledge of at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project or work experience

Preferred:

Introductory or intermediate training in cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Completion of relevant healthcare data analytics coursework or professional development (e.g., AHIMA, CPHIMS, or equivalent)
Exposure to AI-augmented analytics tools or data storytelling training

Skills & Competencies

Technical/Role-Specific Skills

SQL & Data Querying: Solid, hands-on SQL skills for data extraction, filtering, joining, and basic transformation across relational databases; ability to write and maintain queries for recurring analytical needs.

Healthcare Data Domains: Working knowledge of medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data structures, with growing familiarity with EDI standards (834/837), ICD-10/CPT codes, and CMS data formats.

BI & Data Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools for building and maintaining operational dashboards, standard reports, and data summaries for business and compliance audiences.

Data Quality & Validation: Ability to apply data quality checks, identify anomalies, and validate outputs against source data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance readiness across healthcare datasets.

Data Documentation: Demonstrated ability to write and maintain clear analytical documentation including query logic, data dictionaries, source-to-target notes, and process runbooks.

Cloud Platform Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud data environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and willingness to develop hands-on proficiency in cloud-native analytics tools such as Databricks or Azure Data Factory.

Analytical Communication: Ability to translate data findings into clear written summaries and visualizations that support non-technical stakeholders in making informed operational decisions.

Licensure

Required: None

Preferred: None

Essential Physical Functions

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.
The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay Range: $98,550.00 - $147,825.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

jobs.title: Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Strategy Analyst supports executive and health system leadership across the enterprise by translating complex internal, market, and industry datasets into actionable strategic insights. Operating within the Business Development department, this role focuses on evaluating market share dynamics, optimizing ambulatory and inpatient access points, supporting service line planning, and supporting enterprise capacity planning. The ideal candidate combines strong quantitative modeling skills with healthcare domain fluency to inform capital allocation, network expansion, and long-term strategic planning.

Essential Functions

Market Share & Competitive Intelligence: Analyze external claims, state inpatient/outpatient discharge databases, and demographic data to evaluate market share trends, competitor positioning, migration patterns, and whitespace opportunities across primary and secondary service areas.
Service Line Analytics: Partner with service line executives and physician leaders to assess clinical program performance, volume trajectories, payer mix shifts, contribution margins, and downstream referral patterns.
Access Point & Network Optimization: Conduct geospatial and catchment area analyses to evaluate ambulatory footprint performance, site-of-care shifts, clinic utilization, and optimal locations for new facilities or service expansions.
Capacity Planning & Demand Forecasting: Build quantitative models to project inpatient bed demand, procedural room utilization, and ambulatory capacity constraints based on population health trends, clinical acuity, and operational throughput.
Executive Decision Support: Synthesize multi-source findings into clear, executive-ready presentations and business cases that guide strategic planning, partnership evaluations, and capital investments.

***Hybrid in Franklin, TN strongly preferred. Fully remote considered for standout candidates with exceptional experience***

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Economics, Data Science, Finance, Statistics, Public Health, or a related quantitative field required; Master’s degree (MHA, MPH, MBA, or MS in Analytics) is strongly preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in healthcare strategy, management consulting, decision support, or quantitative analytics.
Direct experience working within a hospital, multi-hospital health system, payer, or healthcare consulting environment strongly preferred.

Technical Background: Experience working with large-scale healthcare datasets (e.g., Epic/Cerner EHR extracts, Cost Accounting/Decision Support systems, state/all-payer claims data, CMS datasets, or syndicated market intelligence platforms such as Sg2, Advisory Board, or Claritas).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Understanding of hospital and ambulatory operations, healthcare reimbursement models, service line economics (e.g., DRGs, APCs, RVUs), and competitive market dynamics.
Analytical & Data Visualization Skills: Proficiency in Excel for complex data analysis and financial/volume modeling; demonstrated ability to build intuitive visuals in Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
Strategic Communication: Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint to design clean, structured, executive-ready slide decks. Ability to distill technical analyses into concise business narratives for executives, clinical leaders, and other non-technical stakeholders.
Project Management & Collaboration: Self-directed with strong organizational skills to manage multiple competing strategic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining rigorous attention to analytical accuracy.
