new_jobs.title: Program Manager, DIGITAL Project
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision

Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

About The DIGITAL Project

DIGITAL (Digital Integration for Grid Interconnection Tools, Analysis, and Logic) is a $90M project funded by a Department of Energy (DOE) grant and GridUnity cost share under the DOE’s Grid Resilience and Innovation Partnerships (GRIP) Program. The project's objective is to accelerate the interconnection of energy resources to the U.S. electric grid by shortening the complete interconnection lifecycle.

About The Role

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Program Manager owns the administration and execution of the DIGITAL project end to end. This role will drive successful delivery by hitting project milestones, managing the $90M project budget, surfacing risk early and actioning mitigations, and submitting DOE deliverables.

This is a heavy execution role that also requires coordination across all GridUnity departments. The DIGITAL project plan is fulfilled by GridUnity's Product, Engineering, Customer Experience, and FinOps teams, so you will work across every part of the company to keep the project plan synchronized with the product roadmap and actual customer delivery. You will be the connective tissue between the goals of the DIGITAL project, what GridUnity develops and deploys, and what we report and invoice to the DOE. You should be equally comfortable running a milestone review with product and engineering leads, walking a DOE project officer through a quarterly report, and defending the project's spend plan line by line.

Responsibilities

Project plan and execution

Own the Project Management Plan (PMP) and drive execution of the project plan across all tasks: schedule, milestone log, deliverables log, metrics, and risk register.
Run the project's operating cadence: Milestone reviews, cross-functional status, and executive updates so that progress is visible and decisions get made on time.
Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience to ensure the PMP accurately reflects the progress of the product roadmap and customer deployment, and manage formal updates to the plan when actual delivery and the baseline plan diverge.

Budget management

Manage the project to its approved budget: track actuals against the spend plan by task and budget category, across both federal share and GridUnity cost share.
Identify budget under- and over-utilization early, work with finance and functional leads on corrective action, and manage re-budgeting when needed.

Risk management

Own the project risk register: identify emerging gaps between planned milestones and current trajectory, surface them with options rather than surprises, and drive mitigation to closure.
Monitor dependencies across workstreams and escalate conflicts between project commitments and other company priorities.

DOE reporting, invoicing, and compliance

Prepare and submit DOE reporting deliverables including quarterly progress reports and annual go/no-go review materials
Own preparation of invoices to DOE, ensuring costs are allowable, allocable, and supported by documentation that will stand up to audit.
Demonstrate the value of actualized spend in advancing the project's goals: connect dollars spent to milestones achieved, software released, and deployments completed in every report and review.
Serve as day-to-day point of contact with the DOE project officer and grants management specialist, and coordinate GridUnity's responses to DOE requests.

Qualifications

Director-level program or project management experience (10+ years), with a record of owning large, multi-year programs end to end: plan, budget, risks, and reporting.
Experience with Department of Energy awards, as a recipient, contractor, or DOE staff, including federal reporting, invoicing, and the mechanics of managing the award
Background in the electric grid and utility sector; familiarity with interconnection strongly preferred.
Experience managing programs built on SaaS product delivery. Comfortable working with product and engineering teams on roadmaps, release cycles, and agile development.
Strong cross-functional operator: able to drive outcomes through teams that don't report to you, from engineering leads to finance to executives.
Excellent written communication; able to produce federal-grade reports and briefings independently
Project Management Professional certification or equivalent is a plus. U.S. work authorization requi

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

Benefits/Perks

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one
Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you
401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (technical content)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Prowess Consulting is a technology consultancy that helps some of the world’s largest technology enterprises define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We invest the time to deeply understand our clients’ technologies, customers, and business objectives so we can help them develop the strategies and stories they need to succeed in the market.

Who You Are

Prowess is looking for a detail-oriented, efficient problem solver with experience managing engineering and content development projects to successful completion, ideally in a fast-paced consulting or marketing agency environment. You’re comfortable using AI to take on the administrative side of project management so you can spend more of your time on clients, the team, and quality.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time or role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please
.

THE ROLE

As a Project Manager, you are central to keeping our projects on track, our clients and stakeholders satisfied, and our project team feeling connected and accomplished. On any given day you might review test results with engineers, animation storyboards with graphic designers, and a draft white paper with a client, all while keeping timelines, scope, and budget on track. You’ll manage multiple projects in parallel for leading high-tech companies worldwide.

AI is taking over much of the administrative layer of project management and we see that as an opportunity. We want PMs who use that freed-up time for what people do best: facilitating decisions, building client trust, supporting the team, and raising the quality bar. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should have hands-on experience with AI and real curiosity about how fast they’re changing.

Responsibilities

Project delivery

Manage engineering and content development projects for tech clients from kickoff through closeout.
Lead client kickoff calls and align teams on scope, deliverables, templates, and review cycles.
Coordinate activities, handoffs, and deliverables across engineers, writers, editors, and designers.
Build and manage full lifecycle project plans and schedules for multiple projects in parallel.
Run focused working sessions that drive decisions, unblock teams, and keep progress moving week over week.

Client and stakeholder management

Generate clear status reports and executive emails highlighting progress, open items, and risks.
Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact; address and escalate client concerns as needed.
Expertly facilitate meetings by reading, prioritizing under time pressure, and deciding when to push for a decision and when to take a topic offline.

Budget, scope, and risk

Manage project budgets, hours, and margin, including scope and change requests.
Identify risks early and bring recommendations, not just problems.

AI-enabled ways of working

Use AI to handle routine project work, such as meeting notes, status drafts, schedule updates, and risk tracking, while staying fully accountable for accuracy.
Review AI-generated output with sound judgment, internal policies and client requirements.
Share tips with teammates and help improve team templates, SOPs, and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

4+ years of project management experience, preferably in consulting or marketing agencies.
Strong interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
Experience managing projects with technical content, such as benchmark testing, technical research, or white papers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple platforms.
Proven experience handling complex, highly fluid projects and challenging clients.
Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
Hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day work.
Solid experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

Preferred

Experience building simple automations or AI agents (for example, Power Automate or Copilot agents).
PMI’s Project Management Professional (PMP) credential; AI-focused project management training is a plus.

Additional Details

The offered pay range for this position is $80,000–$90,000 per year, depending on experience and geographic location.

We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Description

Fauna Robotics is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end program execution for a robot hardware system, driving cross-functional teams from concept through production ramp. You will lead hardware development milestones across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software domains. You shall maintain supplier engagement, manufacturing readiness, and cross-site coordination. This role partners directly with product management, applied science, and executive stakeholders to define strategy, remove blockers, and deliver robots that are as delightful as they are capable.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end program execution for a robotic hardware system from concept through design verification, pilot, and production ramp.
Work with product management, applied science, and executive stakeholders to define program strategy, requirements, and success criteria.
Deep-dive on key technical issues spanning mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software domains — leading teams to find solutions within program constraints.
Own and maintain cross-functional development schedules, identifying critical path and driving accountability across teams.
Lead hardware development milestones definition
Drive supplier engagement and manufacturing readiness, including travel to vendor sites for prototype builds, tooling reviews, and production validation.
Communicate regularly with senior management on program status, risks, and key decisions — escalating effectively when needed.

Coordinate cross-site execution with remote engineering teams and contract manufacturers.

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of technical product or program management experience

Experience with robotic systems, autonomous vehicles, or complex electromechanical product development
Familiarity with PCBA development, motor/actuator systems, sensor integration, or embedded firmware development cycles
Experience with DFM/DFA principles and manufacturing scale-up of hardware products
Experience managing programs with combined hardware, firmware, and software deliverables

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Operations Project Manager's primary function is to lead the strategy, reporting, tracking and execution of projects for Operations. Coordinates and manages the programming, planning, implementation and monitoring of complex department-wide projects, initiatives, and ongoing efforts. In partnership with the department leadership, uses data, SWOTs and focus groups to analyze issues in order to identify projects that support strategic plans and goals. Ensures the completion of projects are on schedule and meet all program objectives and appropriate regulations. The Project Manager will bring new and innovative ideas, techniques, and opportunities to the forefront to foster continuous improvement in strategy execution. Facilitates cross functional relationships with key stakeholders in order to align goals, strategy, and deliverables.

Essential Functions

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

In collaboration with department leadership, develops and presents business cases to obtain project sponsorship, budget, and resource allocation.
Identifies appropriate project team members and stakeholders and completes a RACI to outline expectations regarding roles and responsibilities.
Manages, assesses, and documents project scope and program, describing the objectives, stakeholder identification, resource requirements, parameters, risks and benefits of the project, timelines and tracks and communicates ongoing performance against goals.
Develops and maintains project charters to include purpose, objectives, scope, risk mitigation, metrics, timeline, communication plan, and deliverables, debrief, and measurements.
Documents current and future-state processes and oversees the development and implementation of operational workflows.
Ensures projects are progressing at appropriate timelines. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity and quality goals and deliverables.
Monitors project deliverable progress and impacts and adjusts as needed.
Manages communications on a regular and timely basis, ensuring that all project participants are informed of project status, barriers, and required actions. Creates communication and change management plans for all types of stakeholders. Conducts project debrief sessions, identifies lessons learned, and applies the lessons learned to future projects.
Captures data, performs analysis, interprets results, develops summaries, and generates optimal, effective, and innovative visual display to inform and operationally support department leaders and business operation improvement initiatives and priorities.
Manages complex information (e.g. large data sets), conducts analyses and develops visual displays on a regular basis in collaboration with the department leaders to help identify needs, drive results, and measure effectiveness. Supports operational leaders and team by developing and managing metrics to enable data driven decisions.
Implements quality control measures to ensure project compliance with department, hospital, and university policies, government codes and regulations. Ensures conformance to the requirements of all project participants.
Identifies when project proposals are warranted by using data analytics, survey data, SWOTs, workforce planning, and focus groups. Conducts a root cause analysis and problem statement.
Develops and manages implementation plans for all projects. In collaboration with applicable partners, develops and implements training around project deliverables that result in changes in process, procedures, policy, etc.
Continuous evaluation of workflow processes. Leads process optimization efforts by leveraging usage of technology.

None required. Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred

Ability to apply judgment and make sound decisions.
Ability to foster effective working relationships and build consensus.
Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, work independently and meet deadlines.
Ability to work effectively both as a team player and leader.
Ability to work effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization.
Knowledge of Windows-based office software, computers and operating systems.
Knowledge of research processes, data development, data analysis, syndicated data and consumer information resources.
Experience in using effective project management tools and methods.
Ability to work in a matrix environment with multiple stakeholders and clients.

This role will be based remotely in Canada.

If you are passionate about making an impact in an organization that’s committed to creating a sustainable future, consider joining our team!

Lead end‑to‑end delivery of enterprise consulting projects, from planning and scoping through implementation, closeout, and lessons learned.

5+ years of experience in project management.

Experience working with GIS software in project management, consulting or operations role.

new_jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend
is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend
is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of retail banking branch renovation and refresh programs. The ideal candidate will be client-focused, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple fast-paced projects while ensuring consistency, quality, budget adherence, and minimal disruption to banking operations. Role requires 25%-30% regional travel to project sites when required.

Responsibilities

Manage multiple branch renovation and retail banking improvement projects from initiation through closeout.
Coordinate and manage stakeholders including banking clients, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, facilities teams, and regulatory authorities.
Develop, monitor, and maintain project schedules, ensuring key milestones, critical paths, and delivery commitments are achieved.
Ensure effective project governance, standards, processes, and reporting frameworks are consistently applied across all projects.
Prepare and deliver project status reports, executive summaries, risk registers, and leadership updates.
Oversee the execution of branch renovations to ensure compliance with client design standards, brand requirements, security protocols, and operational needs.
Manage project budgets, forecasts, change orders, and cost controls to ensure projects are delivered within approved financial parameters.
Coordinate planning and execution activities to minimize disruption to branch operations, customers, and employees during renovations.
Facilitate communication between internal stakeholders, construction teams, vendors, and banking operations teams through regular meetings and project updates.
Monitor design development, permitting activities, procurement schedules, construction progress, and project closeout requirements.
Manage contractor and consultant performance, ensuring quality, safety, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
Review project documentation, drawings, schedules, budgets, and contractor deliverables to ensure alignment with project goals.
Lead issue resolution efforts, including responding to field conditions, RFIs, change requests, and operational challenges.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to support successful project delivery.
Support value engineering initiatives and recommend cost-effective solutions without compromising quality, customer experience, or regulatory compliance.
Ensure all renovations are completed in accordance with applicable building codes, accessibility requirements, life safety standards, and banking security guidelines.
Maintain strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.
Identify opportunities for program improvements, process efficiencies, and expanded services within the retail banking portfolio.
Support business development efforts by fostering positive client relationships and identifying future project opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience managing retail, banking, corporate interiors, renovation, or construction projects.
Experience overseeing multi-site renovation programs and fast-track project delivery environments.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and construction administration.
Experience working in occupied facilities while maintaining business continuity.
Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, and project management software platforms.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (technical content)
new_jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Prowess Consulting is a technology consultancy that helps some of the world’s largest technology enterprises define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We invest the time to deeply understand our clients’ technologies, customers, and business objectives so we can help them develop the strategies and stories they need to succeed in the market.

WHO YOU ARE

Prowess is looking for a detail-oriented, efficient problem solver with experience managing engineering and content development projects to successful completion, ideally in a fast-paced consulting or marketing agency environment. You’re comfortable using AI to take on the administrative side of project management so you can spend more of your time on clients, the team, and quality.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time or role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please
.

THE ROLE

As a Project Manager, you are central to keeping our projects on track, our clients and stakeholders satisfied, and our project team feeling connected and accomplished. On any given day you might review test results with engineers, animation storyboards with graphic designers, and a draft white paper with a client, all while keeping timelines, scope, and budget on track. You’ll manage multiple projects in parallel for leading high-tech companies worldwide.

AI is taking over much of the administrative layer of project management and we see that as an opportunity. We want PMs who use that freed-up time for what people do best: facilitating decisions, building client trust, supporting the team, and raising the quality bar. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should have hands-on experience with AI and real curiosity about how fast they’re changing.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project delivery

Manage engineering and content development projects for tech clients from kickoff through closeout.
Lead client kickoff calls and align teams on scope, deliverables, templates, and review cycles.
Coordinate activities, handoffs, and deliverables across engineers, writers, editors, and designers.
Build and manage full lifecycle project plans and schedules for multiple projects in parallel.
Run focused working sessions that drive decisions, unblock teams, and keep progress moving week over week.

Client and stakeholder management

Generate clear status reports and executive emails highlighting progress, open items, and risks.
Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact; address and escalate client concerns as needed.
Expertly facilitate meetings by reading, prioritizing under time pressure, and deciding when to push for a decision and when to take a topic offline.

Budget, scope, and risk

Manage project budgets, hours, and margin, including scope and change requests.
Identify risks early and bring recommendations, not just problems.

AI-enabled ways of working

Use AI to handle routine project work, such as meeting notes, status drafts, schedule updates, and risk tracking, while staying fully accountable for accuracy.
Review AI-generated output with sound judgment, internal policies and client requirements.
Share tips with teammates and help improve team templates, SOPs, and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

4+ years of project management experience, preferably in consulting or marketing agencies.
Strong interpersonal skills, diplomacy, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
Experience managing projects with technical content, such as benchmark testing, technical research, or white papers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple platforms.
Proven experience handling complex, highly fluid projects and challenging clients.
Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
Hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day work.
Solid experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

Preferred

Experience building simple automations or AI agents (for example, Power Automate or Copilot agents).
PMI’s Project Management Professional (PMP) credential; AI-focused project management training is a plus.

Additional Details

The offered pay range for this position is $80,000–$90,000 per year, depending on experience and geographic location.

Prowess Consulting is an equal-opportunity employer, and diversity is a core value for us. We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Prowess Consulting, we are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. We provide a well-rounded benefits package including health insurance, flexible spending account, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan investing. For more information, please visit www.prowessconsulting.com.

new_jobs.description:
Help bring renewable energy projects closer to grid connection by keeping technical delivery, customer commitments, and project finances aligned. As a Technical Project Manager at Opoura, you will lead Power Engineering projects from start to finish, connecting the people and decisions needed to deliver them.

Based in Porto, you will join a team that collaborates closely across Europe and the US and works side by side with Software and SCADA colleagues to make sure control requirements and operational realities are reflected in our analyses.

Your role

You will report to Gil Almeida, Project Manager & Team Lead, and be based at our Porto office, where we currently have six colleagues.

You will join the Power Engineering department within Opoura’s Digital Services business unit. The team works with customers on grid studies and connection processes for power plants, collaborating with Software and SCADA colleagues to reflect control requirements and operational data in its analyses.

You will be the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate engineering teams and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Working closely with the Power Engineering Manager, you will align resource planning and priorities with project commitments.

This is a project delivery role for someone who can engage confidently with power systems and grid connection requirements. You will lead technical clarifications and challenge assumptions and deliverables, while the engineering team remains responsible for technical design and calculations.

Key responsibilities

Own the delivery of Power Engineering projects from initiation through completion, managing scope, schedules, budgets, quality, dependencies, and customer commitments.
Coordinate customers, engineers, grid operators, and external partners, keeping technical interfaces, responsibilities, and deliverables clear.
Lead technical clarifications and review engineering deliverables against project requirements, grid codes, and applicable connection standards.
Manage project risks and deviations, resolve or escalate issues, and keep stakeholders informed of decisions and progress.
Maintain financial control, including budget monitoring and invoicing, and partner with the Power Engineering Manager on resource planning and priorities.
Contribute to consistent project governance and delivery practices that improve predictability and make effective use of engineering capacity.

To be successful in this position, you

Build customer trust through clear communication and reliable follow-through.
Apply sound technical judgment, knowing when to challenge an assumption and when to bring in engineering expertise.
Anticipate delivery risks and address them before they affect commitments.
Balance customer expectations, technical requirements, project finances, and available resources.
Bring structure to complex work while keeping decisions and communication practical.

Your background

You combine project management experience with a solid understanding of electrical power systems. You are comfortable discussing technical requirements with engineers and customers without needing to perform detailed engineering work yourself.

We imagine that you bring:
Experience managing technical projects with responsibility for scope, schedules, budgets, and delivery.
A solid understanding of power systems, electrical engineering, and grid connection processes.
Experience coordinating technical interfaces and stakeholders across customer-facing projects.
The ability to interpret grid codes, network standards, and connection requirements, and review their implications for project deliverables.
Familiarity with power system studies and assessments, such as load flow, short-circuit calculations, protection coordination, or reactive power.
Confidence managing technical clarifications and identifying risks in engineering deliverables.

What we offer

You will own projects that connect engineering work with customer outcomes and bring together power systems expertise and practical project leadership.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Work across Power Engineering, Software, and SCADA and engage with customers and other technical stakeholders.
Help strengthen project delivery practices and improve predictability.
Work on grid connection challenges where technical decisions and project delivery meet.
A hybrid role in Porto, with at least two days a week in the office.

The Program Manager partners closely with Business Development, Legal, Contracts, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to convert contractual commitments into executable plans, resolve complex issues, protect Aldevron's business interests, and build durable strategic client partnerships.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead Program and Project Execution: Lead highly complex, multi-program portfolios across strategic accounts, owning end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent projects with significant revenue, risk, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring alignment with timelines, budgets, and KPIs.

As a Multi Domain Compliance Program Manager, you will play a key supporting role in helping product, engineering, and compliance teams meet requirements across several compliance domains, including Responsible AI (RAI), Privacy, Accessibility, and the Digital Markets Act (DMA), to help ensure the successful delivery of our client’s software projects.
This role is ideal for a well-rounded program manager who enjoys coordinating cross functional partners, managing structured processes, and helping teams understand and navigate compliance expectations. You will contribute to scaling responsible, safe, and compliant innovation through strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please .

Cross Domain Program Coordination & Support
Support compliance teams in managing and updating feature inventories for multiple compliance programs.
Help organize regular reviews of new features and experiences; assist in capturing decisions and tracking follow-up actions.
Partner with engineering teams to help ensure they have the right information and resources to complete required compliance reviews.
Identify opportunities to streamline cross domain workflows and contribute suggestions to improve operational efficiency.

Maintain clear communication channels with stakeholders, providing regular updates on bug resolution progress.

Provide support with ADO work items related to compliance activities, including updates and partner team follow ups.

Capture clear meeting notes, decisions, next steps, and action items to help maintain alignment across all participating teams.

Risk & Confidentiality

Handle sensitive compliance information responsibly and follow established data protection practices.

4–10 years of experience in program or project management, ideally supporting compliance, governance, regulatory, risk, accessibility, privacy, or similar cross functional initiatives.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into structured tasks for engineering and product teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with comfort working across diverse groups and levels.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) and Power BI, or similar tools, for tracking and reporting.
Ability to learn quickly across multiple compliance domains and support SMEs, even without deep specialization in any one domain.
Experience contributing to process improvements, workflow optimization, or compliance enablement programs.

The offered pay range for this position is $105,00 – 120,000 per year, depending on experience and geographic location.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.
This role is ideal for a structured, customer-centered operator who can bring clarity to complex situations, build alignment across teams, and translate individual escalations into systemic improvements.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will help customers operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We create opportunities to learn, grow, and master your craft in a high-growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, support each other, and hold ourselves accountable to high standards.

In this role, you will:

Own priority customer escalations end to end, including triage, action planning, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and real-time status updates to customers and executive stakeholders.
Serve as the single-threaded owner for complex escalations, creating structure and accountability across Sales, Finance, Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other partner teams.
Deliver clear post-mortems and executive summaries; track resolution progress, commitments, and follow-up actions through closure.
Analyze escalation themes and quantify business impact to identify and prioritize opportunities for process, product, and workflow improvement.
Lead cross-functional programs to improve the customer experience – standardize escalation workflows, service-level expectations, tooling, reporting, and dashboards.
Coach frontline teams on escalation prevention, de-escalation, customer communication, and effective use of escalation processes.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.

Success in this role will be measured by:

Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for high-severity escalations.
Improved post-escalation CSAT and NPS.
Increased percentage of systemic issues permanently fixed within 90 days.
Consistent SLA adherence and audit-ready escalation documentation.
Clear stakeholder accountability and completion of commitments arising from escalations.

Minimun requirements for the role: 

4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Support Operations, Trust & Safety, incident management, or a related function, including direct ownership of high-severity escalations.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional process-improvement programs from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to use data to make decisions, quantify impact, and prioritize work.
Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders in time-sensitive situations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex situations into clear executive-level updates and recommendations.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

PMP, ITIL, Six Sigma, or a comparable program, incident, or process-management certification.
Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or other complex customer-operations environment.
Experience building or improving escalation playbooks, SLAs, operating rhythms, dashboards, or audit-ready documentation.
Experience coaching customer-facing teams on conflict resolution, de-escalation, and prevention.

Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary: $102,042 USD - $154,350 USD
Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Description

The Moores Cancer Center (MCC) is one of just 53 NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Centers in the United States and the only one in San Diego County. As a consortium cancer center, it is a collaborative partnership between the UCSD: encompassing 28 departments, 6 schools (School of Medicine, Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, School of Public Health, Jacobs School of Engineering, School of Biological Sciences & the School of Physical Sciences), UCSD Health oncology hospitals and clinics; the basic and public health research and outreach of San Diego State University (SDSU), and the basic and translational research of the La Jolla Institute of Immunology (LJI). These various programs and units are all dedicated to fulfilling the Moores Cancer Center's mission of reducing cancer's burden. As such, it ranks among the top centers in the nation conducting the continuum of cancer research, providing advancedpatient care, and serving the community through outreach and education programs. As a top-ranking, future-oriented organization, we offer challenging career opportunities in a fast-paced and innovative environment. Moores Cancer Center follows a progressive philosophy ofcareer-path development for its employees including opportunities for cross-training, professional development, and progressive responsibility.

MCC's mission is to transform cancer care in our catchment area and beyond by driving exceptional scientific discoveries and innovations in prevention, detection, care, and training. MCC will make a global impact on improving health by reducing cancer burden through accelerateddiscovery and translation, compassionate and interdisciplinary care, education and community engagement, with the foundation of our core values - Excellence, Innovation and Risk-Taking, Collaboration, Diversity and Service.

The Clinical Trials Office (CTO) at UCSD's Moores Cancer Center administers many clinical trials on behalf of its member investigators, including trials sponsored by National Cancer Institute cooperative groups, pharmaceutical companies, and physician investigators.

Reporting directly to the CTO Associate Director, Clinical Operations, the Disease Team Project Manager supervises the day-to day activities of Clinical Research Coordinators, Data Coordinators and Long Term Follow-Up Coordinators of a specified Disease Team, including oversight and coordination of a large portfolio of complex oncology clinical studies. The incumbent is directly responsible for ensuring the team’s adherence to protocols, appropriate management and distribution of the clinical research workload, ensuring CRC and Data Coordinator compliance with sponsor requirements and federal regulations overseeing auditing and monitoring visits. The Disease Team Manager is responsible for supervising, administering, and achieving operational goals and objectives for implementation within his/her specific Disease Team, and is directly responsible for the management of Disease Team staff.

The incumbent will also play a key role in leading and managing pre-study site selection visits (PSSVs) including liaising with all appropriate medical service units (e.g., Investigational Drug Service, Pathology, Radiology, etc.) for the conduct of the trial, managing quality assurance and quality improvement goals and objectives. Provides direct supervision typically to professionals or skilled technical employees. Functions as advisor to unit and administration.

Analyzes and resolves problems, interprets policies (e.g., fiscal management, HR, contracts and grants, resource management in defined areas) and demonstrates solid subject matter knowledge. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action. Supervises staff to assure accountability and stewardship of department resources (operational, financial, and human) in compliance with departmental goals and objectives.

Supervises staff responsible for working with departments, staff, patients and families in using clinical research techniques. May assume full responsibility for the research in delegated studies. Receives assignments in the form of objectives with goals and the processes by which to attain them. Supervises daily operations, and performance requirements. Has full oversight for staffing, performance management, and programmatic workflow of project.

Coordinates and oversees clinical trials from inception through completion, including approvals, initiation (site visit coordination), and start up procedures, protocol implementation, recruitment, screening, enrollment, data management, maintenance of subjects, writing publications and finalization of sponsor requirements. Oversees and analyzes complex databases. Compiles data reports as needed. Provides team, investigators, and clinical fellows with guidance regarding study design and logistics. Supervises staff work assignments and schedules to meet clinical research goals and timelines. Meets regularly with assigned staff to set goals and ensure objectives are being met. Supports patient recruitment plan development and execution, in conjunction with the Office of Community Outreach and Engagement (COE) and other Marketing, Communications and Business Development functions. Work with PIs and Director to plan and implement multiple phase I, II & III studies in assigned disease group. In conjunction with the Regulatory Affairs Manager and Start-Up Project Manager, monitor and ensure regulatory paperwork is submitted to the scientific committee for proposal review and monitor progress of regulatory approvals. Independently participate in onsite study monitoring visits, demonstrating proficiency in data management practices. Assure timely and accurate design and submission of reports, proposals and data collection instruments (instruments includes surveys and equipment for the study), with minimal protocol deviations and mitigations against delayed data entry

Supervises staff responsible for working with departments, staff, patients and families in using clinical research techniques. Participates in recruitment and orientation of new employees. Recommends salary actions, promotions, and terminations. Conducts necessary personnel actions for assigned staff including disciplinary actions. May assume full responsibility for the research in delegated studies. Receives assignments in the form of objectives with goals and the processes by which to attain them. Supervises daily operations, and performance requirements. Supervises staff work assignments and schedules to meet clinical research goals and timelines. Works with the Disease Team members to implement structural changes within the Disease Team and reassign projects as needed to maximize time efficiency within the constraints of limited resources. Trains and mentors staff to improve quality and quantity of work. Has full oversight for staffing, performance management, and programmatic workflow of project.

Minimum Qualifications

Nine years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five years of related experience/training.
Clinical Trial Professional certification from a professional society within one year in position.
Broad knowledge of clinical or laboratory research and clinical research philosophy. Demonstrated ability to translate clinical research philosophy into business best practices in a trial setting.
Demonstrated project management skills. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, prioritize projects and meet the demands of a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. Adaptable to quickly changing priorities.
Demonstrated experience managing people with a wide range of educational backgrounds and skills. Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others. Demonstrated experience in training others in the field of research.
Demonstrates good problem-solving and analytical skills. Creatively addresses complex or new problems.
Strong communicator; includes verbal and written, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills. Clear and concise communicator. Ability to influence and negotiate.
Excellent interpersonal skills, including but not limited to: problem-solving, teamwork development, leadership, mentorship. Interpersonal skills to effectively motivate others. Works well with others to achieve common goals. Ability to cultivate relationships with multiple stakeholders at various levels of administration.
Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software. Effectively uses campus' clinical information and documentation application programs. Proven ability utilizing clinical trial management systems.
Skills to work collaboratively with other cross-functional teams. Ability to interface and collaborate with other members of an extended study team. Ability to influence / persuade. Proven ability to effectively coordinate and integrate programs with others in division, department, and organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree.

new_jobs.description:
About Primordial Labs

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Program Manager to own a portfolio of programs across the full program lifecycle, from proposal and negotiation through contract award, execution, and fielding. You’ll work with the growth team to capture new and follow-on work, then serve as the single point of accountability for delivering on our commitments, on time. You’ll lead the day-to-day execution of your programs with support from Program Management Staff, setting the plan, making the calls, and keeping customers and leadership informed.

This role suits someone with 7+ years of program management experience, including time in an ownership role, who wants full accountability for outcomes and enjoys developing the people around them at a company where decisions get made quickly.

What You'll Do

Program Ownership & Execution:

Own one or more programs end to end, from contract award through fielding and sustainment.
Set program baselines for scope, schedule, cost, and performance, and manage execution against commitments.
Own the program schedule and budget, review schedule status and spend with Program Management Staff, and lead corrective action when programs drift.
Proactively make and document decisions on risk, tradeoffs, and recovery plans without waiting for escalation.
Work across the program management team and other stakeholders to integrate dependencies and balance competing priorities.

Proposals & New Business:

Partner with the growth team to capture new and follow-on work, shaping customer requirements and solution approaches.
Lead the program management portions of bids, including technical approach inputs, schedules, staffing plans, and basis-of-estimate development.
Lead or support customer negotiations, owning the program’s position on scope, schedule, and cost.

Contract Deliverables & Compliance:

Own contract deliverables, reviewing and approving work drafted by Program Management Staff and engineering before submission.
Manage period-of-performance milestones, invoicing, and government reporting.
Ensure contract terms are met, manage contract modifications, and flag issues to leadership early.

Customer & Stakeholder Leadership:

Serve as the primary program point of contact for external customers and internal stakeholders.
Lead program reviews and briefings for government and internal leadership.
Travel to support customer shaping, demonstrations, test events, and program reviews.

Process & Team Leadership:

Direct and mentor Program Management Staff, delegating schedule, deliverable, and meeting-preparation work and helping them grow toward program management roles.
Establish repeatable program management processes, cadence, templates, and tools that scale across multiple programs.
Coordinate product, engineering, operations, test, and business teams to meet or exceed program commitments and shape follow-on work.

About You

Experience:

7+ years of program management experience on defense or government programs, with at least three years in an ownership role.
Hands-on experience delivering to DoD customers and navigating acquisition processes
Track record of delivering hardware, software, or integrated systems to fielding.
Experience leading proposal efforts and customer negotiations for government work.

Skills:

Demonstrated success leading remote, cross-functional teams and developing junior program management staff.
Strong command of schedule, cost, and risk management across multiple concurrent programs.
Clear written and verbal communication, including briefing senior government and military leaders.
Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-moving environment.

Security Clearance:

Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with USSOCOM organizations, SOF mission context, or JSOC customer sets.
Experience in business development and shaping follow-on work.
Active Secret or TS/SCI security clearance.
Experience with earned value management (EVM).
PMP or similar certification.
Experience at a startup or small defense technology company.

Important Qualification Note:
Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $160,000 - $200,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

Our Benefits

Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.
100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).
Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.
Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.
Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.
Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

Our Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!
Manager Interview: A 45-minute discussion about relevant program concepts and your past experience.
Team Interviews: Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. During this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. If you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

At Opoura, our Digital Services business brings together engineering, technology, consulting and security expertise to support customers across energy and critical infrastructure. Our projects span Power Engineering, OT & SCADA and Managed Security Services, covering everything from grid connection studies and power system modelling to infrastructure and cybersecurity.

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Project Manager who can combine strong project management skills with commercial understanding and a customer-focused mindset.

Your role

As our new Commercial Project Manager, you will take responsibility for the commercial and financial performance of assigned projects while coordinating delivery across our technical teams and business units.

You will be a key point of contact for customers, ensuring clear communication, alignment on expectations and structured follow-up throughout the project lifecycle.

Based at our headquarters in Silkeborg, you will work closely with Technical Project Managers, specialists, and fellow project managers across Digital Services, alongside colleagues in Sales, Finance, and our Business Controller.

Beyond managing your own projects, you will contribute to developing common project management processes and strengthening project and portfolio reporting across Digital Services.

Your main responsibilities

Manage the commercial and financial aspects of assigned projects, including budgeting, forecasting, invoicing and project P&L.
Lead customer dialogue, manage expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout project delivery.
Coordinate project scope, planning, milestones and resources in collaboration with technical project teams.
Identify and manage project risks, changes and commercial implications.
Support Sales with project estimates, budget quotations and delivery planning.
Work closely with Finance and the Business Controller to ensure accurate financial follow-up and monthly management reporting.
Contribute to developing and implementing practical, shared project management processes across Digital Services.

To be succes in this role

You combine commercial awareness with a structured and pragmatic approach to project management.

You understand how project decisions affect financial performance, customer relationships and delivery commitments. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing the right people together and keeping projects moving forward.

You communicate clearly with both technical specialists and commercial stakeholders, and you know when to challenge, escalate or find a practical solution.

Most importantly, you take responsibility for your commitments and enjoy creating structure and progress in a technically complex environment.

Your background

We imagine that you bring:
At least five years of experience in commercial project management, including direct customer contact and responsibility for project financials and delivery coordination.
Solid experience with budgeting, forecasting, invoicing, project planning and risk and change management.
Practical experience with structured project delivery, primarily using waterfall-based approaches.
A PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent project management certification.
Confidence working with project management, financial and reporting tools. Experience with Business Central and Power BI is an advantage.
Fluent Danish and strong English communication skills.

A relevant higher education qualification is preferred, although practical project management experience is more important to us.

Experience from renewable energy or the wider energy sector is an advantage, but not a requirement. We also welcome candidates from engineering services, technical consulting, IT/OT, infrastructure and cybersecurity.

The position is based in Silkeborg and involves occasional travel to customers, project sites and other Opoura locations.

You will join a collaborative environment where technical expertise and commercial understanding come together to deliver solutions for customers operating complex energy and critical infrastructure.

Ownership of your own projects, with responsibility for both customer relationships and commercial performance.

TEVET is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Job Summary

TEVET is seeking a hands-on Program Manager to drive the day-to-day execution and operational performance of assigned customer programs supporting the aerospace and defense industry. This position translates customer requirements into coordinated operational plans, monitors commitments and performance, leads customer operational reviews, and drives cross-functional issues through resolution. The Program Manager also manages assigned customer onboarding, program transitions, tool crib program support, and operational improvements.
The role leads the BAE Order Management (OM) team and coordinates across other functions without direct supervisory authority over those teams. Buyers retain responsibility for sourcing, purchasing decisions, and supplier management. The Program Manager communicates program priorities and customer impacts, coordinates dependencies, and works with functional leadership to resolve barriers to execution. The role also partners with TEVET’s BAE Account Manager to support the ABACO business, with specific responsibilities and decision authority established with the Account Manager and Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance

Manage daily work assignments and priorities for the BAE OM team to support customer requirements and program commitments.
Monitor team workload, order accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through; address performance gaps and barriers to execution.
Provide coaching, training, and feedback to strengthen team capabilities and consistency.
Establish clear expectations and conduct performance reviews in accordance with company practices.
Coordinate team coverage and communicate staffing or resource needs to the Director of Supply Chain Operations.
Promote accountability, collaboration, adaptability, and customer service within the team.

Program Management & Execution

Drive day-to-day execution of assigned customer programs against customer requirements, contractual commitments, and agreed priorities.
Develop and maintain practical operational plans with clear milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and action items.
Maintain visibility into open orders, delivery commitments, program exceptions, and outstanding issues.
Monitor program performance and identify risks that could affect service levels or customer commitments.
Develop and coordinate corrective action plans with responsible teams, following issues through resolution.
Balance multiple programs and time-sensitive requirements, resolving priorities within established authority and involving leadership when necessary.
Manage assigned customer onboarding, program implementations, process changes, and operational transitions.
Maintain program reporting, performance reviews, and action-item tracking.

Customer Relationship & Communication

Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned customer programs.
Maintain regular communication with customers regarding performance, priorities, delivery expectations, and outstanding issues.
Lead operational meetings, program reviews, and issue-resolution discussions.
Communicate risks, changes, and corrective actions promptly, using information validated with the responsible teams.
Set realistic expectations and follow through on commitments.
Partner with the Account Manager and TEVET leadership on concerns requiring commercial decisions, additional resources, or leadership intervention.
Build productive working relationships that support customer confidence and TEVET’s business interests.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Order Management

Coordinate activities across order management, procurement, sales, and other teams to support program execution.
Communicate customer requirements, program priorities, and delivery impacts to the responsible teams.
Lead the BAE OM team in resolving order discrepancies, missing information, fulfillment exceptions, and stalled handoffs.
Obtain relevant purchasing and supplier delivery updates from buyers to support program planning and customer communication.
Ensure cross-functional issues have an accountable owner, an agreed next step, and a target completion date.
Drive follow-through on agreed actions and escalate unresolved dependencies, missed commitments, and priority conflicts.
Work with other functional leaders to address shared resource constraints and recurring operational barriers.
Develop and maintain customer-specific order management procedures and ensure team activities follow established company processes and applicable customer and contractual requirements.

Tool Crib Program Support

Coordinate TEVET’s administrative and order management support for customer tool cribs.
Track supplier shipments based on crib usage and coordinate timely processing of related TEVET paperwork.
Maintain accurate records of each crib PO’s funded amount, amounts applied against the PO, and remaining available balance.
Reconcile shipment information and supporting documentation, working with the appropriate parties to resolve discrepancies.
Provide shipment status and PO funding updates to the Account Manager and designated stakeholders.
Identify and communicate approaching funding limits, documentation gaps, or shipment issues that could interrupt crib support.
Track funding-related follow-up actions with the Account Manager and responsible parties to support continuity of service.

ABACO Business Support

Partner with the BAE Account Manager to support operational execution and customer requirements associated with the ABACO business.
Coordinate assigned program activities, customer communications, reporting, and issue resolution.
Maintain visibility into related orders, delivery commitments, risks, and outstanding actions.
Work with responsible teams to address operational barriers affecting customer commitments.
Support assigned implementations, transitions, and process improvements.
Carry out additional program responsibilities as defined with the Account Manager and Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor agreed operational measures, including order accuracy, delivery performance, issue aging, action completion, and customer communication.
Monitor tool crib shipment documentation and PO funding balances to identify discrepancies and continuity risks.
Use metrics and feedback to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Implement practical improvements within assigned program and order management responsibilities.
Partner with functional owners on improvements affecting other teams’ processes.
Assess whether corrective actions achieve the intended results and address recurring problems.
Provide leadership with clear reporting on program performance, risks, and decisions needed.

Business Agility & Ownership

Independently manage assigned responsibilities and competing deadlines.
Adapt team priorities and program plans as customer needs and operational conditions change while keeping commitments clear.
Investigate problems, identify practical options, and take action within established authority.
Use collaboration and sound judgment to move work forward across teams.
Recognize when an issue requires another functional owner, the Account Manager, or leadership to make a decision.
Follow through consistently without requiring constant direction.
Balance customer needs with TEVET’s capabilities, commitments, and business interests.
Role boundaries: Buyers retain ownership of sourcing, supplier selection, purchasing decisions, supplier relationships, and purchasing issue resolution. The Program Manager manages BAE OM team assignments, workload, development, and performance. Other functional leaders retain responsibility for their respective teams. The Program Manager coordinates program dependencies, communicates customer impacts, and drives agreed actions forward.

Success Measures

Deliver program commitments by driving assigned activities against customer requirements, contractual commitments, and agreed milestones.
Maintain customer confidence through accurate, timely communication, effective reviews, and consistent expectation management.
Resolve risks and issues by identifying risks early, coordinating practical corrective actions, and maintaining clear ownership and follow-through.
Lead effective team and cross-functional execution with clear BAE OM priorities, assignments, coverage, and performance expectations, while coordinating dependencies and handoffs across other functions.
Improve program performance through measurable gains in operational accuracy, efficiency, follow-through, or customer satisfaction, including reliable tool crib documentation and funding visibility.
Evaluation will consider BAE OM team performance and shared program results alongside the Program Manager’s leadership, planning, coordination, communication, corrective action, and escalation within the role’s authority.

Qualifications

Demonstrated success in order management, customer operations, supply chain coordination, program management, or a related operational role.
Experience managing complex customer orders, delivery commitments, and operational exceptions.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and drive issues through resolution.
Experience communicating directly with customers and handling operational concerns or escalations.
Ability to lead, coach, and develop the BAE OM team while gaining cooperation across other functions without direct supervisory authority over those teams.
Ability to organize work into clear priorities, milestones, responsibilities, and follow-up actions.
Strong attention to detail, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills; ability to maintain accurate operational information, funding records, and reporting.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and independently manage competing demands.
Experience using ERP, order management, or business reporting systems; proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting aerospace, defense, manufacturing, distribution, or government-contractor customers.
Prior supervisory, team lead, mentoring, or employee training experience.
Experience coordinating customer programs, leading operational reviews, or managing customer onboarding.
Experience supporting tool crib programs, tracking customer PO funding, or reconciling shipment documentation.
