new_jobs.title: Investigations Analyst, Safety, NAST
new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you interested in working on a fast-paced team that pioneers ways to improve safety and compliance within North American Surface Transportation (NAST)? Do you enjoy digging into the details of an event and tracing it across multiple systems until you have a clear answer? Are you motivated by challenging problems where the answer isn't handed to you?

Amazon's NAST Safety & Compliance team, within Middle Mile Investigations (MMI), is seeking a detail-oriented Investigations Analyst to determine whether Amazon loads, equipment, or carrier relationships were involved in reported safety events across our carrier programs: Relay Marketplace Carrier (RMC), RMC LineHaul (RMCLH), RMC Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

Working within established investigation workflows and SOPs, with periodic review and guidance from the Program Manager, you'll review source documents such as police and crash reports, then match what they show (trailer and tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against internal load, assignment, and location records. Each event ends in a clear, documented determination of whether Amazon had involvement, backed by the evidence behind it. Along the way you'll spot issues that need follow-up, such as events that were never reported, or loads moved by a carrier other than the one assigned, and route them to the right partner teams. An ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, has strong attention to detail, is vocally self-critical, and collaborates well in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Key job responsibilities

Investigation

Conduct assigned incident investigations from intake through documented finding across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP, determining whether an Amazon load, asset, or carrier relationship was involved.
Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash-camera footage, law enforcement and crash reports, and carrier documentation.
Match physical evidence (trailer/tractor plates, DOT numbers, carrier and driver details) against load, assignment, and location records.
Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
Write clear investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, with every line sourced to verifiable data, so partner teams can act without re-investigating.
Serve as a point of contact on assigned incidents to internal stakeholders.

Analysis & escalation

Identify events needing follow-up (unreported incidents, mis-assigned loads) and route them to the appropriate partner teams.
Query and reconcile data across multiple transportation systems to support investigations.
Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices for Program Manager review.

Operating rhythm & process improvement

Work a steady queue of cases against turnaround expectations, keeping case records and queue status current and auditable in the systems of record.
Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness and escalate vendor performance issues.
Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
Flag recurring data or process gaps that slow investigations, and propose improvements to investigation standard work and SOPs.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About The Team

Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety & Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is geographically distributed, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. If you enjoy detailed problem-solving and are comfortable with ambiguity, you'll do well here.

Basic Qualifications

High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional or military experience
2+ years of experience working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications
Experience with investigations, auditing, risk management, compliance, or safety

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst, or equivalent role
Experience with end-to-end project management

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Program Manager, Enterprise Risk Management, reports directly to the Director, Enterprise Risk Management. This role supports and advances CapMetro's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program through the execution of enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement activities. This position works collaboratively with executives, department leaders, project teams, and other stakeholders to facilitate risk assessments, maintain the enterprise risk inventory, monitor risks and opportunities, develop reports, dashboards, and presentations, and coordinate ERM activities. The Operational Lead provides consultative guidance, tools, and expertise to business units while serving in a facilitative and advisory capacity to support effective risk management. The position supports the Organizational Strategy & Projects leadership team in embedding risk-informed decision-making and fostering a risk-aware culture through sound risk management practices and program enhancement.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Note: The duties and primary responsibilities below are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this job and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. 

Enterprise Risk Management Program Administration

Support the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of CapMetro’s Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program, including risk appetite, risk tolerance, policies, procedures, tools, metrics, and templates.
Drive the integration of risk analysis, management, and recommendations into strategic planning, organizational objectives, and business decision-making.
Develop and deliver enterprise risk reporting, dashboards, risk maps, trend analyses, and executive, Board, and governance communications.
Maintain ERM program documentation, risk records, templates, reporting artifacts, and document repositories, ensuring accuracy, completeness, version control, and retention of program information.

Risk Identification, Assessment, Prioritization, and Monitoring

Maintain the enterprise risk register, facilitate enterprise and departmental risk assessments, and identify, assess, prioritize, and communicate risks and opportunities affecting strategic and operational objectives.
Monitor risk trends, emerging risks, key risk indicators (KRIs), and enterprise exposures against established risk appetite and tolerance thresholds, escalating material deviations as appropriate.
Develop and enhance risk monitoring and mitigation practices, including early warning systems, preventive controls, mitigation tracking, post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of risk management processes.

Business Partnership, Culture, and Influence

Foster a culture of risk awareness, collaboration, and transparency through stakeholder engagement, education, coaching, and constructive communication.
Partner with business leaders and serve as a trusted advisor to facilitate informed risk-based decision-making while reinforcing business ownership and accountability for risk.
Support change management and organizational transition initiatives by guiding cross-functional teams through the adoption of new processes, tools, and analytical practices, helping facilitate workforce readiness, user adoption, and successful integration of risk management into organizational decision-making and ERM objectives.
Promote analytical rigor and risk-informed thinking by developing organizational capabilities, methodologies, and practices that strengthen risk analysis, support data-driven decision-making, and embed risk discipline across the organization.

Strategic Project & Capital Program Risk Support

Partner with strategic initiative, capital project, program, and portfolio teams to assess, review, and manage risks associated with major capital investments and strategic initiatives, promoting cross-functional integrated risk management and informed decision-making.
Facilitate project risk workshops and monitor risk mitigation activities to support effective project risk management and decision-making.

Organizational Stewardship

Perform responsibilities in a manner that supports CapMetro's mission, values, strategic goals, and commitment to organizational excellence.
Support Capital Metropolitan Transportation Authority’s Safety Management Systems (SMS) process by following safety and security policies, considering safety in every action and reporting safety and security concerns.
Perform other duties as required and/or assigned in support of the CapMetro Strategic Plan.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING

Bachelor’s degree in risk management, business, economics, finance, public administration, management, or related field.
Eight (8) years of relevant experience in risk management, audit, compliance, governance, strategic planning, public administration, or related disciplines, including three (3) years of experience leading enterprise assessments, governance initiatives, and cross-functional business programs, with two (2) years of management experience managing employees or projects.
Preferred - Professional risk management qualification such as Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA), Enterprise Risk Manager (ERM), International Certificate in Enterprise Risk Management (IRM), Financial Risk Manager (FRM).
Preferred - Experience in public transportation, infrastructure, utilities, government, aviation, or large capital project environments.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Comprehensive knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) principles, frameworks, and practices, including risk appetite, risk tolerance, and industry standards such as COSO ERM and ISO 31000.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to perform qualitative and quantitative risk analysis, identify trends, evaluate impacts, and synthesize data from multiple sources to support decision-making.
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and program documentation in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to develop, maintain, and continuously improve systems, processes, documentation, and records that support effective risk management and program operations.
Proficiency in developing reports, dashboards, presentations, and other communication materials that effectively convey risk information and recommendations.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, with experience developing reporting tools, dashboards, document repositories, and executive-level presentations.
Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse technical and non-technical audiences and adapt messaging to stakeholder needs.
Ability to influence, collaborate, build consensus, and maintain productive working relationships across all levels of the organization, while exercising sound judgment, professionalism, initiative, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Work is generally performed in an office environment in which there is only minimal exposure to unpleasant and/or hazardous working conditions. This position works with multiple project timelines and performs work of a complex nature.

Incumbent must have the ability to stand and sit frequently throughout an eight-hour period, reach vertically for overhead use as well as horizontally. Must be able to use a telephone or headset equipment. Incumbents must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs., perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day, and function in an environment with constant interruptions. Regular and predictable attendance at assigned work location is an essential function.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disability to perform the essential functions as previously described.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

Mobility Status

As a Hybrid position, onsite presence is guided by team collaboration needs, customer and front-line team member interactions, and role responsibilities. People leaders will set expectations for onsite presence; however, incumbents are generally encouraged to work 8 to 12 days in office per month. Mobility status is subject to change at any time based on business needs or organizational decisions.

COMMITMENT TO EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CapMetro is an equal employment opportunity employer and committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, pregnancy, age, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Position Summary

The Operations Analyst is the single source of truth for the Pharma order stack. Sitting between the Business Unit (BU Leader, Account Manager, Order Entry) and the production floor, this role knows where every order is, what is ahead, what is behind, and why. The analyst gets that answer first-hand - from the ERP, the work centers, and the people running them - so no one else has to chase it.

The role combines data analytics with strong relationships across the organization. The analyst partners with the scheduling, production, and procurement teams, tracks orders against the master schedule, and feeds ground-truth status back from the floor. The analyst reports status and risk; the scheduling, production, and procurement owners fix the causes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Order tracker ownership: Owns the single source of truth of the Pharma order stack. Responsible for keeping it up to date, clean, and current.
Order tracking: Maintains real-time status of every open order from released PO to shipment. Verifies at the work center, not by email.
Data and analytics: Pulls and reconciles ERP data to build and maintain the tracking data, dashboards, and weekly reporting. Core metrics include on-time delivery, schedule adherence, WIP aging, and committed vs. projected ship dates.
Floor presence: On the production floor daily. Builds working relationships with supervisors and leads in every department an order touches.
Scheduling, production, and procurement partnership: Works with the scheduling, production, and procurement teams to track orders against the master schedule and material status, and feeds ground truth back from the floor. Supports the schedule but does not own it.
Ahead/behind analysis: Identifies slipping orders, quantifies the gap, and pinpoints the cause (unreleased prints, material shortages, capacity conflicts).
Early warning: Flags risk to the BU Leader and Account Manager before it hits a commit date - with the data and recovery options.
Delay patterns: Maps order flow from PO to ship and identifies recurring delay drivers. Hands findings to the owners to fix.
BU support: Provides status details for internal reviews and customer updates. Not customer-facing.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related engineering discipline - or equivalent job-shop experience.
2-4 years in production control, planning, scheduling, expediting, or operations analysis in a manufacturing or job-shop environment. Internships and co-ops count.
Advanced Microsoft Excel required (pivot tables, lookups, reconciling large data sets). Power BI or similar a plus. Will be tested in the interview.
ERP/MRP experience pulling order, routing, and labor data.
Reads engineering drawings, BOMs, and routings.
Comfortable on a production floor. Builds credibility with shop leads.

Experience in a regulated, HIPAA-compliant data environment with PHI/PII datasets

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
First Merchants Bank is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our team! This position is a highly technical, business-focused analytics professional responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that improve the performance of the Consumer Line of Business (LOB). This role combines advanced Microsoft SQL or Snowflake SQL development, data analysis, analytical modeling, data visualization, automation, and AI-enabled analytics to solve complex business problems and support strategic decision-making. The Senior Data Analyst develops scalable analytical datasets, reporting solutions, dashboards, and models; identifies emerging trends, opportunities, and risks; and translates analytical findings into clear business recommendations. The position also leverages generative AI and emerging analytical technologies to improve the speed, quality, consistency, and scalability of analytics while maintaining appropriate validation, data quality,
governance, and human oversight. This position can be remote within our operational footprint.

As Part Of This Role You Will

Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL within Snowflake or Microsoft SQL to extract, transform, integrate, and analyze large and complex datasets.
Develop reusable analytical datasets, transformations, business logic, and data assets that support reporting, dashboards, modeling, and strategic analysis.
Integrate information from multiple and disparate data sources to create reliable, consistent, and scalable analytical solutions.
Develop and implement data-quality checks and validation processes to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and appropriate for business use.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recurring data and reporting processes.
Perform exploratory, diagnostic, and advanced analysis to identify business trends, performance drivers, risks, relationships, and opportunities.
Design, develop, test, validate, document, and maintain analytical models used to support Consumer business decisions.
Apply appropriate analytical and statistical techniques, including forecasting, segmentation, propensity analysis, scenario analysis, optimization, and other quantitative approaches.
Lead and/or support analytical modeling for business applications such as staffing, network planning, variable compensation, goal setting, customer behavior, growth, retention, and other Consumer LOB initiatives.
Effectively use generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate data discovery, SQL development, analytical workflows, documentation, research, quality assurance, automation, and problem-solving.
Critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs before incorporating them into analytical products or business recommendations.
Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging analytical technologies to improve processes, reduce manual effort, enhance analytical capabilities, and improve decision-making.
Design, develop, deploy, and maintain dashboards, business reports, and executive-ready data visualizations that provide clear insight into key performance indicators and business drivers.
Monitor business, customer, operational, and financial data to identify meaningful changes in performance and emerging trends.
Deliver insights and recommendations regarding potential areas of growth, optimization, efficiency, and performance improvement.
Conduct ad hoc analysis in response to emerging business priorities and strategic questions.
Partner across Consumer LOB departments and other areas of the organization to develop data driven strategies that improve business processes and decision-making.
Translate ambiguous or complex business questions and stakeholder requirements into clearly defined analytical approaches, reporting deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
Communicate analytical findings, methodologies, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Lead and/or participate in special projects as needed, including upgrades, integrations, new data sources, technology enhancements, and analytical initiatives.

To be successful in this position, we require the following:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, data analytics, data science, statistics, management information systems (MIS), business analytics, economics, finance, business, or a related quantitative field OR associate degree/two (2) years of college plus two (2) years of related work/military experience OR four (4) years of related work/military experience, plus the additional required experience listed below.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, business analysis, analytics engineering, data science, or a related analytical discipline.

The Following Would Be a Plus

Advanced hands-on experience with Snowflake SQL or Microsoft SQL, including complex queries, joins, common table expressions (CTEs), window functions, data transformations, data validation, large datasets, and development of reusable analytical datasets, with the ability to rapidly become proficient within the Snowflake environment.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language for data analysis, modeling, or automation.
Experience with Power BI or a comparable business-intelligence and visualization platform to develop dashboards, reports, or analytical solutions and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Experience developing, applying, validating, or maintaining analytical models to support business decisions, including statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive modeling, experimentation, optimization, or other advanced analytical methods.
Practical experience applying generative AI, copilots, large language models, or AI-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly within analytical, coding, documentation, automation, or problem-solving workflows.
Ability to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and explain results clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Experience in banking, financial services, consumer analytics, or another highly regulated industry.
Experience analyzing customer acquisition, engagement, retention, profitability, product performance, channel behavior, or similar consumer-business outcomes.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects concurrently.

Base Pay PLUS Bonuses
Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
401k
Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
Vacation/Sick Time
Paid Holidays
Paid Parental Leave

new_jobs.title: Sr Data Analyst - Driving Empire
new_jobs.description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Role Overview

🏎️ Driving Empire is the #1 driving game on Roblox, with around 20 million monthly players and 500+ million rows of data generated every day. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst
to be the go-to expert on that data and a close partner to the team shaping the game’s future.

You’ll own Driving Empire’s analytics end to end
, from designing telemetry and building data models to running A/B tests, creating dashboards, and maintaining our AI analytics agent. You’ll work side by side with product managers, game designers, and our partnerships, licensing, and marketing teams to turn player data into clear insights and recommendations. Your work won’t sit in a report:
your analyses and tests will shape decisions that go live within days or weeks, not quarters. 🚀

It’s also a chance to work on a game that partners with world-famous automotive and entertainment brands, on one of the biggest UGC platforms in gaming. If you love data, games, and cars, and want to see your impact on millions of players quickly, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Partner closely with product managers and game designers, using data to shape feature design and game priorities
Own the full A/B testing process: design, spec, set-up, analysis and recommendations
Deliver post-mortem analyses and key learnings after major updates and live events, and suggest what to test next
Run deep dives into player behaviour, such as churn, conversion, LTV and player segments
Investigate changes in key KPIs and deliver clear root cause analyses
Build dashboards and regular reports
Contribute to the weekly Numbers Review alongside the PM, shared with the whole company
Work with game designers on balancing, review balancing changes before release, and playtest and support releases
Spec telemetry for upcoming features, and help improve how telemetry is documented, specced and checked
Maintain and develop Driving Empire's dbt models and data structure
Maintain and develop the semantic view, skills and AI analytics agent for Driving Empire, and keep them accurate
Provide insights, projections and reporting for partnerships, franchise, licensing and marketing
Take part in cross-game and team-wide projects, and bring new methods and tools to the team

Who You Are

3–5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role
2+ years of games industry experience strongly preferred (mobile, F2P, live service, or UGC platforms)
A product mindset: you understand how features affect player behaviour, engagement and monetisation, and use data to shape product decisions
Deep understanding of core gaming KPIs (such as DAU, retention, ARPDAU, conversion and LTV) and what drives them, as well as game economies and monetisation techniques
Deep A/B testing expertise, from design and sample sizing to analysis, interpreting both statistical significance and practical impact
Experience with advanced analyses, such as cohort analysis, player segmentation, KPI forecasts and churn models
Advanced SQL (complex queries, window functions, performance tuning) on large datasets
Experience designing clear, complete telemetry that answers product and design questions
Experience with cloud data warehouses (we use Snowflake, but Redshift, BigQuery, or similar is welcome)
Proficiency with a data visualisation tool (we use Tableau, but Looker, Power BI, or similar is welcome)
Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for analysis
Clear, accurate, well-organised written reports, adapted for technical and non-technical readers

Nice to Have

Understanding of how AI agents and semantic views work
Experience building scalable data models with dbt, including data quality tests and documentation
Python proficiency for deeper analysis and automation

Bonus Points for

Experience working on Roblox games, or familiarity with the Roblox platform
Passion for racing and driving games
Passion for cars!

Tech Stack

SQL (primary tool)
Snowflake (data warehouse)
dbt (analytics engineering)
Tableau (data visualisation and dashboards)
Excel / Google Sheets
Python (optional but beneficial)
Git (version control for analytics code)
AWS (cloud infrastructure)
Claude and Claude Code

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status

Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:

💰 Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options

⛳️ Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!

🩺 Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.

🏖 Flexible PTO - vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays

🌎 Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere

🎮 In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!

🎓Professional Development - Reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further their training and growth

🎉 Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Data Analyst – Technology is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for querying, analyzing, and reporting on Medicare Advantage healthcare data to support operational decision-making and regulatory compliance across technology operations. This role works closely with the Senior Data Analyst, product managers, and platform engineers to translate business requirements into analytical outputs — including reports, dashboards, and data validations — within an agile development environment. The Data Analyst builds foundational expertise in healthcare data domains including claims, member/eligibility, and provider data, and contributes to the team's data quality and documentation standards. This position is a key development role on the path toward senior-level analytical ownership and growing specialization in Medicare Advantage data platforms.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Querying: Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — in support of operational reporting and ad hoc analytical requests.

Requirements Gathering Support: Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies and assist in translating business requirements into analytical specifications, data mappings, and reporting logic under the guidance of senior team members.

Reporting & Dashboard Support: Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools that present healthcare data clearly for operational and compliance audiences.

Data Quality Validation: Apply data quality checks, validate source-to-target mappings, and identify anomalies or inconsistencies in healthcare datasets to support data integrity and audit readiness.

Regulatory & Compliance Reporting: Support the production of HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter, and risk adjustment reporting outputs by executing defined analytical processes and validating results against established data standards.

Documentation & Process Support: Maintain analytical documentation — including query libraries, data dictionaries, and process notes — to support team knowledge continuity and operational handoff requirements.

Continuous Learning & AI Awareness: Develop familiarity with cloud data platforms, data modeling concepts, and AI-assisted analytics tools, and actively build skills that support growth toward the Senior Data Analyst level.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Experience

Job Requirements

Required:

3–5 years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a closely related analytical function
Demonstrated hands-on experience writing SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation in a production or near-production environment
Experience working with healthcare data, including at least one of the following domains: medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, or provider data
Working knowledge of reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI platform
Familiarity with working in an agile or scrum team environment, including participation in sprint ceremonies and iterative delivery
Experience in a regulated data environment with exposure to data quality validation, HIPAA requirements, or PHI/PII handling practices

Preferred:

Experience in a Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or managed care health plan environment
Exposure to CMS reporting requirements, HEDIS measures, STAR ratings logic, or risk adjustment data
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data transformation tools (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)
Experience applying AI-assisted or automated analytics tools to routine analytical workflows

Education

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Informatics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered

Preferred:

Progress toward or completion of a Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline

Training

Required:

Demonstrated proficiency in SQL through direct work experience; equivalent hands-on experience accepted in lieu of formal training
Working knowledge of at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project or work experience

Preferred:

Introductory or intermediate training in cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Completion of relevant healthcare data analytics coursework or professional development (e.g., AHIMA, CPHIMS, or equivalent)
Exposure to AI-augmented analytics tools or data storytelling training

Skills & Competencies

Technical/Role-Specific Skills

SQL & Data Querying: Solid, hands-on SQL skills for data extraction, filtering, joining, and basic transformation across relational databases; ability to write and maintain queries for recurring analytical needs.

Healthcare Data Domains: Working knowledge of medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data structures, with growing familiarity with EDI standards (834/837), ICD-10/CPT codes, and CMS data formats.

BI & Data Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools for building and maintaining operational dashboards, standard reports, and data summaries for business and compliance audiences.

Data Quality & Validation: Ability to apply data quality checks, identify anomalies, and validate outputs against source data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance readiness across healthcare datasets.

Data Documentation: Demonstrated ability to write and maintain clear analytical documentation including query logic, data dictionaries, source-to-target notes, and process runbooks.

Cloud Platform Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud data environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and willingness to develop hands-on proficiency in cloud-native analytics tools such as Databricks or Azure Data Factory.

Analytical Communication: Ability to translate data findings into clear written summaries and visualizations that support non-technical stakeholders in making informed operational decisions.

Licensure

Required: None

Preferred: None

Essential Physical Functions

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.
The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay Range: $98,550.00 - $147,825.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

It’s about insights that are out of sight.

Does diving into a 1,000-piece puzzle and placing all the pieces excite you? Are you passionate about finding solutions to problems and enjoy the freedom of making those decisions? Do you like working with others to deliver solutions? If so, being a Data Analyst Supervisor with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who You Are

As a Data Analyst Supervisor
with Frost, you will be responsible for utilizing quantitative and qualitative analysis tools to provide data-driven insights that help the business achieve its strategic goals and priorities. You will use your analytical skills, innovative personality and desire to build relationships to collaborate with multiple lines of businesses. These insights will help you understand the problem at hand and create an analysis plan to leverage the appropriate data and data analysis techniques. More than that, our supervisors have a genuine care for people and enjoy developing people and do it with integrity, caring and excellence in mind.

What You’ll Do

Supervise and lead Data Analyst I’s, Data Analyst II’s, and College Interns, providing guidance and mentorship to develop their skills and ensure team success
Collaborate with the line of business to understand complex problems and develop comprehensive analysis plans leveraging the appropriate data and techniques to address them
Partner with the line of business to select and monitor KPI’s that best measure the success of implemented solutions
Collect, organize, and integrate data from internal and external sources to perform advanced and complex analyses
Employ advanced statistical and analytical techniques to derive actionable insights and solve business challenges
Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to Product Teams, the line of business, and senior management, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
Support the development and enhancement of BI reporting solutions, creating impactful data visualizations to convey insights to stakeholders clearly and effectively

new_jobs.title: Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Strategy Analyst supports executive and health system leadership across the enterprise by translating complex internal, market, and industry datasets into actionable strategic insights. Operating within the Business Development department, this role focuses on evaluating market share dynamics, optimizing ambulatory and inpatient access points, supporting service line planning, and supporting enterprise capacity planning. The ideal candidate combines strong quantitative modeling skills with healthcare domain fluency to inform capital allocation, network expansion, and long-term strategic planning.

Essential Functions

Market Share & Competitive Intelligence: Analyze external claims, state inpatient/outpatient discharge databases, and demographic data to evaluate market share trends, competitor positioning, migration patterns, and whitespace opportunities across primary and secondary service areas.
Service Line Analytics: Partner with service line executives and physician leaders to assess clinical program performance, volume trajectories, payer mix shifts, contribution margins, and downstream referral patterns.
Access Point & Network Optimization: Conduct geospatial and catchment area analyses to evaluate ambulatory footprint performance, site-of-care shifts, clinic utilization, and optimal locations for new facilities or service expansions.
Capacity Planning & Demand Forecasting: Build quantitative models to project inpatient bed demand, procedural room utilization, and ambulatory capacity constraints based on population health trends, clinical acuity, and operational throughput.
Executive Decision Support: Synthesize multi-source findings into clear, executive-ready presentations and business cases that guide strategic planning, partnership evaluations, and capital investments.

***Hybrid in Franklin, TN strongly preferred. Fully remote considered for standout candidates with exceptional experience***

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Economics, Data Science, Finance, Statistics, Public Health, or a related quantitative field required; Master’s degree (MHA, MPH, MBA, or MS in Analytics) is strongly preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in healthcare strategy, management consulting, decision support, or quantitative analytics.
Direct experience working within a hospital, multi-hospital health system, payer, or healthcare consulting environment strongly preferred.

Technical Background: Experience working with large-scale healthcare datasets (e.g., Epic/Cerner EHR extracts, Cost Accounting/Decision Support systems, state/all-payer claims data, CMS datasets, or syndicated market intelligence platforms such as Sg2, Advisory Board, or Claritas).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Understanding of hospital and ambulatory operations, healthcare reimbursement models, service line economics (e.g., DRGs, APCs, RVUs), and competitive market dynamics.
Analytical & Data Visualization Skills: Proficiency in Excel for complex data analysis and financial/volume modeling; demonstrated ability to build intuitive visuals in Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
Strategic Communication: Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint to design clean, structured, executive-ready slide decks. Ability to distill technical analyses into concise business narratives for executives, clinical leaders, and other non-technical stakeholders.
Project Management & Collaboration: Self-directed with strong organizational skills to manage multiple competing strategic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining rigorous attention to analytical accuracy.

new_jobs.title: HR Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The HR Data Analyst
will support the day-to-day operations of the HR Analytics function by delivering recurring workforce reports, managing ad hoc reporting requests, maintaining analytics tools and dashboards, and ensuring the accuracy and quality of HR data. You will work closely with HR stakeholders to provide timely insights that support business decision-making.

As part of a rapidly evolving analytics environment, you will also collaborate with frontend and backend engineers on the development of our future-state HR Analytics platform. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build technical and analytical expertise while contributing to the transformation of HR reporting and workforce analytics capabilities.

What You Will Do

Own the delivery of recurring HR reporting and analytics processes, ensuring all scheduled refreshes and reporting cycles are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with agreed business timelines.
Manage ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from HR and business stakeholders, delivering accurate, high-quality outputs within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing existing systems and reporting processes, identifying enhancements and automation opportunities, and partnering with HR stakeholders to translate business requirements into meaningful metrics, reports, and visualizations.
Perform data quality checks and reconciliation activities, investigate discrepancies, and support the continuous improvement of data accuracy, integrity, and reporting reliability.
Collaborate with frontend and backend engineers on the development of the future-state HR Analytics platform by providing business context, supporting requirements validation, contributing analytical expertise, and performing user acceptance testing (UAT).
Support process improvement, automation, and system enhancement initiatives using technologies such as Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, and Excel, with active involvement in testing, validation, and implementation activities.
Build and maintain the HR Analytics knowledge base by documenting reporting logic, metric definitions, business rules, data definitions, standard operating procedures, and system processes to enable consistency, scalability, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Maintain and enhance existing reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions, ensuring they remain reliable, relevant, user-friendly, and aligned with evolving business requirements.

What Will Make You Successful

Must-Have Technical Skills

1–3 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role with a strong focus on data analysis, reporting, and problem-solving.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, PivotTables, Power Pivot, advanced formulas, chart creation, and data analysis techniques.
Basic Power BI knowledge, including report and dashboard development, data visualization best practices, Power Query, bookmarks, dataflows, and foundational DAX calculations.
Basic SQL proficiency for querying, filtering, transforming, and validating data from relational databases.
Understanding of data modelling principles and best practices, including relationships, star schema concepts, data structures, and designing datasets that support reporting and analytics.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining data quality and accuracy.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS, or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
Familiarity with Power Automate and process automation concepts.
Basic knowledge of Python for data analysis or automation.
Experience with SuccessFactors, SAP, or other HR systems.
Exposure to People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, or Workforce Planning environments.
Familiarity with AI productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot.

What Do We Offer

Hybrid work schedule
13th salary (paid in 3 installments)
Additional 5 paid leave days per year (calculated proportionally to the period worked)
Monthly budget to spend on Flexible Benefits Platform
Well-being bonus (1-time bonus after probation period)
A medical subscription (Medicover)
Access to the Bookster platform
